Senses.Explanation: A fixed concession formula that marks the move the speaker has no way to refuse, then spends it. Linji Yixuan mounts the prefect's seat only by bending to the gathering, for in the founders' gate the great matter leaves no room to open the mouth or set a foot, Changsha Jingcen would rather let the hall grow grass waist-deep, and only because he has no way out opens the eye of the ten directions in which no one is not oneself, Fenyang Shanzhao writes the old worthies' east-talk and west-talk off as forced on them by their hearers, and Yuanwu Keqin holds up the robe and says the ancients wore the grubby garment because they could not dodge it, and neither can he refuse this crowd. Ying'an Tanhua calls every word before the stroke grass-clinging and, with no way out, doctors the dead horse, Zhongfeng Mingben reopens the ancients' verse on mistaking the knowing spirit only because he cannot let it pass, Mingjue Cong would bite his teeth shut and twist his nose till the hall grew grass, yet with no way out faces the official's feast, and Yuan'an Liao reads the shout and the staff as first-order muddy-water kindness, then with no way out drags his hearers through mud and water on purpose.

Senses.Explanation: The fourth realm: where thing and principle merging was still a halfway house, every single thing now enters and holds every other thing. Zhenjing Kewen's own six verses on the three realm-views open with the freedom refrain — pig's head in hand, precepts on the lips, brothel left, wine debt unpaid, the bag opened at the crossroads; Miyun Yuanwu raises the same couplet in his hall and then stamps it with his staff: thing with thing nothing obstructed, as-you-wish and free, whatever the hand picks up runs through the whole realm-field; Feiyin Tongrong writes back to a fellow master that cutting off mountains and rivers at one stroke is still only the principle-realm — thing with thing means one range entering numberless ranges with neither face broken; Huanyou Zhengchuan on the birthday day runs the four realms to their end and says they gather up world and world-transcending truth entire. Zhongfeng Mingben climbs his ladder of no-obstruction from the unobstructed heart through every rung until copying the Garland and not copying it are both unobstructed; Tianru Weize tells an assembly the Garland teachers' four realms, the Pure Land gates, and the founding teacher's one line all point at the same one truth; Tianran Hanshi warns that pinning the realms down neatly would only qualify a man to be a lecturer's assistant and lose the school's eye; and Wuyi Yuanlai, answering a letter on where the fourth realm belongs, turns the boundary question back on its asker — if it is the perfect teaching, how could it fail to hold thing with thing?

Senses.PreferredTarget: In every matter there is no obstruction; free to act as one wishes.
AlternateTargets: All affairs are unhindered, and one moves freely.

Senses.Note: Zhenjing Kewen uses this pair as a refrain in a longer verse about the unobstructed teaching realm. Miyun cites him and immediately revoices the pair while handling his staff. Feiyin rejects a merely verbal equation of emptiness with unobstructed activity. Tianran and Xiangyan test the quoted pair against awareness of distinctions and the conduct of precepts. Freedom in the phrase is a Chan question about lived insight, not permission to disregard consequences.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 未嘗存，能隨染淨緣，遂成十法界。淨緣有大小，故證四聖之果而有殊；染緣有重輕，故感六凡之報而不等。要且雖成十法界，界界皆圓。眾生若不圓，則不流轉異類及成佛道；佛、菩薩若不圓，即不隨類應身廣度眾生。但一界悟入，界界無餘；一人迷時，類類各別。各別則不能互攝互融無餘，則何妨問此答彼？所以道：男子身中入定時，女子身中從定出；東方人定，西方起；男身沒，女身彰，如是則何妨母身沒，子身彰？佛佛悟此，不見優劣相，不生人我見，成一真法界。故永嘉云：『夢裡明明有六趣，覺後空空無大千。』蓋法界體各各圓滿具足，只爭悟與不悟。悟則當下透脫，覿體全彰，永斷輪迴。所以相替不得，各要努力。然法界有事、有理、有事理無礙、有事事無礙。未悟之人只見其事，不見其理，業識茫茫，無本可據；若悟之人只據本分一著，蓋天蓋地，無天堂可欣、無地獄可厭，處處圓融、事事無礙。故真淨和尚云：『事事無礙，如意自在。手把豬頭，口誦淨戒，趁出婬坊，未還酒債，十字街頭解開布袋。』」驀拈拄杖云：「事事無礙，如意自在，信手拈來，貫徹法界。佛鬼妖魔，無此無彼，地獄天堂。」卓拄杖云：「一槌粉碎，直令呂氏母子目前相見，烏用如目連入地獄方能救得。」擲拄杖云：「還見麼？」喝一喝，下座。臘八，起閱藏千日禪期，上堂開示，云：「今日陞座無他，蓋為釋迦如來悟道之辰，本山啟建閱藏禪期之日。雖然如是，只此兩端，眾兄弟當知期悟為本、閱藏為末。不見世尊當初棄王宮，入雪山，靜思六載，於臘月八夜舉頭睹明星，忽然大悟。何曾有三藏十二部看閱而悟來？又於靈山會上拈花，迦葉微笑，遂以清淨法眼涅槃妙心付囑傳化，謂之教外別傳。所以阿難問云：『世尊傳金襴袈裟外，別傳何事？』迦葉召云：『倒卻門前剎竿著。』阿難從此大悟，為第二祖。於是，祖祖相承至二十八祖達磨大師，遙觀此方有大乘根器，遂航海來。初見梁武帝，帝問聖諦第一義。眾兄弟！梁武深解教乘故，知聖諦為極致，而不知達磨秉教外別傳之旨，直截一揮便乃不知落處。直至嵩山面壁九年，方得慧可大師來乞安心，被磨一拶，欲覓個心與磨安，盡其精神而不能將得出，便徹見本體，當下休歇。磨亦見他徹底悟處，乃與之印可云：『為汝安心竟。』繼有三祖，亦只見得罪無自性。本體露現，故二祖亦與之印可云：『為汝懺罪竟。』至於六祖，一聞『應無所住而生其心』便乃大悟，又何曾待

Senses.Explanation: ‘The matter belongs to one family’ says that apparently separate ways of acting or teaching can be one affair when seen through. Masters pair it with the warning that, without that understanding, the same field breaks into myriad differences. Muchen Daomin turns the inherited formula around: even while saying 'one family', a hearer can get stuck there, whereas an answer amid differences can be alive. Feiyin Tongrong uses the phrase to press whether ancestral and Tathagata Chan are truly two. Yunwai Xingze asks if anyone who understands his exchange still needs five or six separate houses. At a transmission gathering, Yushan Shangsi calls being here or there and going or coming one affair. Yinyuan Longqi brings Confucian and Buddhist conduct together under a realization tested by social turmoil. Chaozong Tongren says the named Chan houses become transparent without forced harmonizing, then tests why two elders refused a ready answer. Songyuan Chongyue raises his staff and says understanding this puts the matter in one family; missing it leaves a thousand differences.

Entries.SourceTerm: 事存函蓋合，理應箭鋒拄

Senses.PreferredTarget: In events, lid and vessel fit; in principle, arrowpoints meet
AlternateTargets: The matter fits like a lid on its vessel; the principle meets point to point like arrows
Senses.Note: The lid and vessel image names a close fit; the two arrowpoints require a meeting with no gap. Miyin applies the pair to Fayan's response, while Baiyu, Xiaotang, Tizong, Lüyan, and Suru put it to work in separate teachings. Staff gestures, a temple-entry address, and questions about the exact meeting prevent the images from becoming a formula for any convenient answer.

Senses.PreferredTarget: One may serve in office a thousand days and fail in a single morning.
AlternateTargets: A thousand days on duty can be undone by one morning's mistake.
SearchAliases: A thousand days in office one morning's failure
Long service undone in a moment
Senses.Note: At Zhaoqing, Lang Shangzuo overturns a kettle while preparing tea. Wang Yanbin asks how the stove deity could let that happen, and Lang replies that a thousand days of service can fail in one morning. Tianyin says Lang missed the point and offers another answer. Xueguan instead credits Lang's apparent misstep with showing the patron and Mingzhao clearly. Eryin answers the encounter with a different political contrast. Each later comment concerns the answer's fit in the tea encounter, not a general warning about civil service.

Entries.SourceTerm: 事是恁麼事，人須恁麼人

Senses.PreferredTarget: The matter is just such a matter; it takes just such a person
AlternateTargets: This is the sort of task it is, and only the corresponding person can meet it
SearchAliases: such a matter requires such a person Chan
the matter and the person must correspond Zen
Senses.Note: The saying joins a matter of this sort to a person of the corresponding sort. Yuanan, Jizong, Huijue, Shipu, and Pinjixiang use it in talks and instruction about meeting a demanding teaching situation. Pinjixiang immediately turns it around: such a person can bring about such a matter. The relation has to be lived by the person before it is just a verbal description.

Occurrences.Kwic: 作甚麼？古人云：莫守寒巖異草青，坐卻白雲終不玅。惟居士自勉之。與李三夫人與李三夫人前承道愛，情出格外，遙憶慈容，宛如覿面。泰州居止頗靜，無勞分慮，嘗欲道人看城東老母公案，地與時遙，不知近日體究如何？山僧有箇頌子，聊為舉似，盍以良驥追風，或借勢於鞭影也。繡戶臨芝絕品評，何須開宴待瓊英？十分春色遊人醉，一種天香透骨清。向者提得便行，可謂天上天下唯我獨尊，不見有佛可成、有眾生可度，來去自由，如鳥飛空，豈不暢快平生耶？倘其不然，也須自加鞭策始得。與李四夫人與李四夫人向臨貴邑，未及一造高軒，至今猶耿耿也。道人智量過人，辨才越眾，正好從火宅以駕白牛，入化城以躋寶所。否則，不異衣秘摩尼而借光東壁也。惟道人淬礪精光，猛利心志，步步轉身，頭頭脫體。山僧雖有成風之手，於道人分上總屬夏行冬令，更有甚罏𩍁鉗錘哉？時不待人，伏唯珍重。與式玉王居士與式玉王居士雲峰雖隔百里，明眼人何異覿面？居士於日用想加精進矣。雖然，一聞便悟，尚涉程途，佇思停機，白雲萬里。事是恁麼事，人須恁麼人，若少留觀聽，也須朝斯夕斯，念念不間，一朝迸裂，始稱大事了畢，方不孤負己靈而昂藏於天地間也。近日上堂法語奉覽，餘不備。寄衡陽劉氏兄弟寄衡陽劉氏兄弟別來數載，如電光中眨眼相似，世事遷流，更可知矣。遙望家鄉，又不知作何景況也。貧衲竿木隨身，逢場作戲，楚水吳山，殆將歷遍。所謂天地與我同根，萬物與我一體，腳頭腳底，橫三豎四，那管通身泥水，百結拖地。法華禪師頌云：屎臭薰天亦偶然，法華爭敢為君宣。鼻中若有通天竅，一任橫行不著穿。盡大地無不是箇清淨道場，了無罣礙。所念人人有一大事因緣，在聖不增，在凡不減，迥脫塵根，高超言象，遇緣應物，觸處圓成，萬變千奇，不離本際。祗為情生智隔，想變體殊，於諸緣染，濃如膠漆，輪迴六道，無繇解脫。貧衲每懷吾兄弟，未能覿面提持得出苦海，不得不如許葛藤。聊申相為之誠，伏惟各自努力。珍重，珍重。又世人如石火電光，眨眼即是來生，時節不相饒，光陰疾如駛。祗如貧衲見參請者，不論久參晚進，無非全體大用，覿面提持，醍醐毒藥，隨人領解，盍為迷越裳之路，聊作指南之車。若是利根上智，直下知歸，安用貧衲饒舌為也？正謂人人本具。各各不無，者道靈光時時獨露，一涉言詮，便成途轍。眾兄弟皆是英靈漢子，也須知有此段大事，人生必要了明者。不然，

Occurrences.Kwic: 天。曠野林泉，何方不照？千濤萬浪，了不隨流。耀古騰今，蕩然無礙。所以出家之志，必要具此段風光，不枉剃髮染衣，離親別族。且道者段風光又作麼生體取？三更月黑無聲色，萬里風雲得自閒。堪笑水邊林下客，目來誰共老僧還？慈雲禪者慈雲禪者去路遠時來路遠，出林深自入林深。驚人浪裏翻觔斗，自有風雲驟足跟。故出家之志，莫謂尋常，必要立一片孤標標氣宇，而能盍天盍地於獅象群中，直須高出人一頭始得。然而此段風光，不假外覓，本來富貴，祇在萬緣頓息，大死一回為佳耳。圓會庵主圓會庵主孤雲野鶴，雪骨冰肌。順則便巢，緣則便住。隨風而起，就境而榮。沖霄漢而不犯天梯，渡江海而不假船筏。一條長性命，今古不磨；半片冷心腸，死生不變。既到恁麼田地，還知恁麼人麼？咄！穿婆裙子拜婆年，翻覆元來是者漢。祥年曾居士祥年曾居士學道無他，只在尋常日用；施為不別，貴乎日用尋常。定志清心，分邪辨正，頭頭過目，法法研窮，用捨分明，無拘巨細，久之自然心心在道，事事符宗，動靜行藏，無非佛事。咦！事是恁麼事，人須恁麼人。徹一覃居士徹一覃居士劫前些子，本自圓成；生後些子，不曾少欠。雖是紅塵滾滾，業識茫茫，要且鼻孔撩天，腳跟點地。所以道：語默動靜，悉是神通；食息起居，總皆玅用。無背無向，不即不離。到者裏，鼻孔依前浮舊面，聞聲見色不支離。一團風味平常處，迷悟何曾隔一絲？還一禪人還一禪人菩提滿目，玅用全身，拈來便是佳珍，觸著無非至寶。象王回顧，獅子嚬呻，十地魂驚，三乘膽顫，只因一人蹋著，群眾皆驚。雖然如是，也須打破者酸齏甕始得。憨之吾孫憨之吾孫靈機暗徹，道眼明開，見境發機，天然自合，此乃現成事也。若就此現成處，再加細密精煉，切磋琢磨將去，始知花笑本從枝上燦，根株原不犯風移。摩天揜日尋常事，瓶瀉曹源水半谿。難先謝居士難先謝居士呼童來啟戶，麤手腳抓破門神；閒看鶴梳翎，尖觜頭搔著癢處。所以冷冰冰一段神機，貴乎暗室睜眉、腦後開眼始得。難先居士舟壓波瀾、竿牚岩岸，一灘一水直上中流，一味打上風頭、直撞湖山，問取第一義下落。老僧祇向他道：搔著癢處情知快，抓破門神日上堂。清風幾陣難遮當，吹得名花遍界香。隆法喬居士隆法喬居士蜀道凌霄漢，川源貫楚湘。江山雖異別，雲月豈分方。且如蘭生幽谷，蓮出污泥，馨香各有其時，動植何分異地。所以聖則未必生成是聖，凡則豈可一定為凡。總

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 作甚麼？古人云：莫守寒巖異草青，坐卻白雲終不玅。惟居士自勉之。與李三夫人與李三夫人前承道愛，情出格外，遙憶慈容，宛如覿面。泰州居止頗靜，無勞分慮，嘗欲道人看城東老母公案，地與時遙，不知近日體究如何？山僧有箇頌子，聊為舉似，盍以良驥追風，或借勢於鞭影也。繡戶臨芝絕品評，何須開宴待瓊英？十分春色遊人醉，一種天香透骨清。向者提得便行，可謂天上天下唯我獨尊，不見有佛可成、有眾生可度，來去自由，如鳥飛空，豈不暢快平生耶？倘其不然，也須自加鞭策始得。與李四夫人與李四夫人向臨貴邑，未及一造高軒，至今猶耿耿也。道人智量過人，辨才越眾，正好從火宅以駕白牛，入化城以躋寶所。否則，不異衣秘摩尼而借光東壁也。惟道人淬礪精光，猛利心志，步步轉身，頭頭脫體。山僧雖有成風之手，於道人分上總屬夏行冬令，更有甚罏𩍁鉗錘哉？時不待人，伏唯珍重。與式玉王居士與式玉王居士雲峰雖隔百里，明眼人何異覿面？居士於日用想加精進矣。雖然，一聞便悟，尚涉程途，佇思停機，白雲萬里。事是恁麼事，人須恁麼人，若少留觀聽，也須朝斯夕斯，念念不間，一朝迸裂，始稱大事了畢，方不孤負己靈而昂藏於天地間也。近日上堂法語奉覽，餘不備。寄衡陽劉氏兄弟寄衡陽劉氏兄弟別來數載，如電光中眨眼相似，世事遷流，更可知矣。遙望家鄉，又不知作何景況也。貧衲竿木隨身，逢場作戲，楚水吳山，殆將歷遍。所謂天地與我同根，萬物與我一體，腳頭腳底，橫三豎四，那管通身泥水，百結拖地。法華禪師頌云：屎臭薰天亦偶然，法華爭敢為君宣。鼻中若有通天竅，一任橫行不著穿。盡大地無不是箇清淨道場，了無罣礙。所念人人有一大事因緣，在聖不增，在凡不減，迥脫塵根，高超言象，遇緣應物，觸處圓成，萬變千奇，不離本際。祗為情生智隔，想變體殊，於諸緣染，濃如膠漆，輪迴六道，無繇解脫。貧衲每懷吾兄弟，未能覿面提持得出苦海，不得不如許葛藤。聊申相為之誠，伏惟各自努力。珍重，珍重。又世人如石火電光，眨眼即是來生，時節不相饒，光陰疾如駛。祗如貧衲見參請者，不論久參晚進，無非全體大用，覿面提持，醍醐毒藥，隨人領解，盍為迷越裳之路，聊作指南之車。若是利根上智，直下知歸，安用貧衲饒舌為也？正謂人人本具。各各不無，者道靈光時時獨露，一涉言詮，便成途轍。眾兄弟皆是英靈漢子，也須知有此段大事，人生必要了明者。不然，

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 天。曠野林泉，何方不照？千濤萬浪，了不隨流。耀古騰今，蕩然無礙。所以出家之志，必要具此段風光，不枉剃髮染衣，離親別族。且道者段風光又作麼生體取？三更月黑無聲色，萬里風雲得自閒。堪笑水邊林下客，目來誰共老僧還？慈雲禪者慈雲禪者去路遠時來路遠，出林深自入林深。驚人浪裏翻觔斗，自有風雲驟足跟。故出家之志，莫謂尋常，必要立一片孤標標氣宇，而能盍天盍地於獅象群中，直須高出人一頭始得。然而此段風光，不假外覓，本來富貴，祇在萬緣頓息，大死一回為佳耳。圓會庵主圓會庵主孤雲野鶴，雪骨冰肌。順則便巢，緣則便住。隨風而起，就境而榮。沖霄漢而不犯天梯，渡江海而不假船筏。一條長性命，今古不磨；半片冷心腸，死生不變。既到恁麼田地，還知恁麼人麼？咄！穿婆裙子拜婆年，翻覆元來是者漢。祥年曾居士祥年曾居士學道無他，只在尋常日用；施為不別，貴乎日用尋常。定志清心，分邪辨正，頭頭過目，法法研窮，用捨分明，無拘巨細，久之自然心心在道，事事符宗，動靜行藏，無非佛事。咦！事是恁麼事，人須恁麼人。徹一覃居士徹一覃居士劫前些子，本自圓成；生後些子，不曾少欠。雖是紅塵滾滾，業識茫茫，要且鼻孔撩天，腳跟點地。所以道：語默動靜，悉是神通；食息起居，總皆玅用。無背無向，不即不離。到者裏，鼻孔依前浮舊面，聞聲見色不支離。一團風味平常處，迷悟何曾隔一絲？還一禪人還一禪人菩提滿目，玅用全身，拈來便是佳珍，觸著無非至寶。象王回顧，獅子嚬呻，十地魂驚，三乘膽顫，只因一人蹋著，群眾皆驚。雖然如是，也須打破者酸齏甕始得。憨之吾孫憨之吾孫靈機暗徹，道眼明開，見境發機，天然自合，此乃現成事也。若就此現成處，再加細密精煉，切磋琢磨將去，始知花笑本從枝上燦，根株原不犯風移。摩天揜日尋常事，瓶瀉曹源水半谿。難先謝居士難先謝居士呼童來啟戶，麤手腳抓破門神；閒看鶴梳翎，尖觜頭搔著癢處。所以冷冰冰一段神機，貴乎暗室睜眉、腦後開眼始得。難先居士舟壓波瀾、竿牚岩岸，一灘一水直上中流，一味打上風頭、直撞湖山，問取第一義下落。老僧祇向他道：搔著癢處情知快，抓破門神日上堂。清風幾陣難遮當，吹得名花遍界香。隆法喬居士隆法喬居士蜀道凌霄漢，川源貫楚湘。江山雖異別，雲月豈分方。且如蘭生幽谷，蓮出污泥，馨香各有其時，動植何分異地。所以聖則未必生成是聖，凡則豈可一定為凡。總

Senses.Explanation: A demanding matter calls for a person able to meet it. Yuanan and Jizong use the pair in instruction on who can meet the matter at hand. Huijue, Shipu, and Pinjixiang apply it to conduct and the teacher's present work.

Senses.PreferredTarget: the matter has no single fixed direction
AlternateTargets: affairs do not run in only one direction
SearchAliases: the matter has no single fixed direction
Senses.Note: The matter has no single fixed direction marks a turn away from treating one response or stance as universally binding.

Senses.Explanation: The matter has no single fixed direction marks a turn away from treating one posture as the only possible response. Wuzu Fayan, Yuanwu Keqin, Wumen Huikai, and Jianfu Chenggu use it after forceful formulations; Baichi Xingyuan opens the matter for the assembly, and Poshan Haiming turns to the immediate festival occasion. Occurrences.Kwic: 開爐，上堂。「廣慧寺裏復開爐，出礦精金會也無？直下不生顛倒見，管教凡聖兩情枯。所以古人道：『凡聖情盡，體露真常，事理不二，即如如佛。』且道佛在甚麼處？塞北千人帳，江南萬斛船。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB185.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Fushi. At a furnace-opening assembly, Fushi Tongxian says that one must see the refined gold rather than revive confused views. He quotes the older account of ordinary and sage feelings exhausted, true constancy exposed, and affairs and principle not two as the Buddha just as things are. Where, he asks, is that Buddha? His answer places a tent for a thousand people north of the frontier and a great cargo ship south of the river. The exact pair is Guishan Lingyou's earlier saying, supported by a named parallel. Fushi's present geographical reply resists simply retaining its elevated description as a separate thing called Buddha.

Occurrences.Kwic: 溈山禪師曰：「事理不二，即如如佛。」《圓覺經》言：「事障理障。」何也？事本無障，以貪欲昏蔽而障之也。理安有障？以黠智偏執而障之也。銷鎔情識，全體自露。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J34/J34nB313.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuzhe Zhi of Qingyuan. In Yuzhe Zhi's collection, a discussion attacks stolen phrases, showy explanations and pride that do not meet birth and death. It explicitly quotes Guishan's nonduality of affairs and principle, then asks why scripture nevertheless names obstacles of each. Affairs are obscured by greed and desire, it answers, principle by clever partial attachment. Long habit is not easily severed, so investigation and learning must continue; the discussion distinguishes ordinary bodily needs to be regulated from arrogance and jealousy to be transformed. The headword is Guishan's quoted statement used in a current practical argument, not permission to declare all habits already harmless because two categories are not separate.

Occurrences.Kwic: 溈山父子，絲來線去，作家則始終作家；逐色隨聲，敗闕則彼此敗闕。若是凡聖情盡，體露真常，事理不二，即如如佛，其奈細如毫末，滿口氷霜。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1397.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xueyan Zuqin. Xueyan Zuqin raises Guishan and Yangshan's exchange about the ancestral intention: a fine lantern, the question whether that alone is it, a returned question, another lantern reply, and a verdict of not knowing. He praises their skill yet criticizes both for following sounds and forms. Even the formula exhausting ordinary and sage distinctions and making affairs and principle not two can leave the mouth full of frost. He draws a circle and asks whether anyone claiming to know the lineage has escaped it, then restages the turns with fresh caps. The headword is his current handling of the formula within that examination, rather than an unqualified endorsement of repeating it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 示眾。古釋迦不前，今彌勒不後，正當今日，凡聖情盡，體露真常，事理不二，即如如佛。我此一眾，人人本具，箇箇圓成，在圓覺大伽藍了。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X71/X71n1420.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chushi Fanqi. Chushi Fanqi says that earlier Shakyamuni is not ahead and present Maitreya not behind: today, when ordinary and sage feelings end and affairs and principle are not two, there is the Buddha as things are. Everyone in his assembly, he says, already possesses this, yet even vast displays of strength do not move a hair beneath the feet. He explains that no fixed teaching or subtle position is established or guarded, and calls only such a retreat worth discussing. The headword is Chushi's current revoicing. Its declaration of completeness is joined to freedom from a held position, not offered as a certificate that each listener has finished all practice.

Entries.SourceTerm: 事理俱無礙，當生即不生

Senses.PreferredTarget: Affairs and principle are unobstructed; in arising there is no arising
SearchAliases: affairs and principle are unobstructed; in arising there is no arising
Senses.Note: “Affairs and principle are unobstructed; in arising, there is no arising” closes a verse attributed to Mazu. Chuiwan asks what understanding these words would reveal. Miyin challenges listeners to answer how birth can be nonbirth. Hengshan voices the pair with a changed preceding line and turns it toward a named monk’s error. These uses join a claim about unobstructed affairs to an immediate test of arising.

Senses.Explanation: The disciplinary code is the body of monastic rules by which conduct is measured. Xuzhou Xingsheng defines carrying out what has been disclosed so that conduct does not go astray as ‘code’ (律). Guxue Zhenzhe cites its requirement that one who has received precepts remain under the conferring authorities, and Fayan Wenyi turns its rule about hearing ornaments through a wall into a public question about violation. Zhongfeng Mingben says Baizhang's monastic regulations drew on this code to establish ritual forms. The records also bend the category: Wuxie Lingmo answers whether he resides according to Chan or the code by saying that he neither keeps the code nor sits Chan, while Dazhu Huihai warns that a code master can bind himself by keeping it. The rule remains concrete even when masters test what keeping it does.

Senses.Explanation: Disciplinary rules are the hard forms that regulate conduct; Chan records preserve them as rules that can be received, followed, broken, or falsely dismissed in the name of freedom. Zhongfeng Mingben criticizes people who break the disciplinary rules and violate prohibitions without fear, then later rejects the opposite error of making secondary observance into a fixed mechanism. His two warnings keep the rule hard without making it the whole Chan test. Zhuanyu Guanheng explicitly glosses the title Daily Disciplinary Rules as the ordinary forms for maintaining conduct in daily use so it is not lost. In a raised case, Shakyamuni Buddha says two monastics have violated the disciplinary rules; Poshan Haiming then reworks how their expulsion and the subsequent request for teaching would be handled. Biographies also record receiving, following, or refusing such rules as concrete acts rather than abstract category.

Senses.Explanation: Disciplinary conduct is the rule-governed conduct that the records describe beings entering or monks violating. Yongming Yanshou says all enter it; Wuyi Yuanlai places entry through it beside entry through fragrant rice or through words as expedient guidance. Entries.SourceTerm: 王令已行天下遍，將軍塞外絕煙塵

Senses.PreferredTarget: The royal decree has reached all under heaven; beyond the frontier the general has ended the dust of war
AlternateTargets: The king’s order is everywhere in force, and the frontier general has put battle to rest
Senses.Note: The line pictures an order already in force everywhere and a general ending the dust of battle beyond the frontier. Linji gives it as one answer in the fourfold person-and-setting exchange. Later masters put the same image into their own encounters to mark a command or answer that leaves no room for further dispute.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: ：「死水不藏龍。」「這一著子，三世諸佛，歷代祖師，滿口道不出。既道不出，將甚麼喚作這一著子？」師曰：「老僧卻疑。」曰：「學人疑此事未明，和尚乃了事之人，還疑個甚麼？」師曰：「老僧不疑，端的向你道了也。」師一日下堂，值止靜次，乃巡香一匝，有燈九盞，一齊吹滅八盞。至佛前，高聲叫曰：「大眾！連這一盞也不消得。」便吹滅，歸方丈。師下堂，乃喝一喝，顧左右曰：「山僧這一喝落在甚麼處？」一眾無語。師才坐，一僧出，師便展兩手曰：「咦！」僧無語，師便打退。又一僧出，師曰：「如何是你本分事？」曰：「腳底兩莖眉。」師曰：「杜撰禪和，如麻似粟。」曰：「老老大大，話頭也不識。」師曰：「老僧不如你。」問：「喚作拳頭則觸，不喚作拳頭則背。喚作甚麼？」師曰：「盞子撲落地，碟子成七片。」僧禮拜，師曰：「盞子撲落地，為甚碟子成七片？」曰：「不會。」師曰：「可惜許！」一僧參南泉斬貓公案，上方丈呈見解，語未竟，被師痛罵。僧出復入，作禮曰：「南泉斬貓意旨如何？」師曰：「王令已行天下遍，將軍塞外絕煙塵。」僧便出，師隨下堂，喚適上方丈問話僧來。僧出，師曰：「道得即放過你，道不得痛與一頓。」僧擬進語，師便打，僧無語，師亂棒打退，僧樁立。復示頌曰：「南泉斬貓，朝打三千。趙州救貓，暮打八百。東西兩堂首座，可為人天眼目。此語有負門，具眼者一笑一哭。」又曰：「把定乾坤皆失色，放開瓦礫也生輝。直饒救得貓兒活，平地無端起骨堆。」一日，有醫士跪師前涕泣。師曰：「何為？」士曰：「求道。」師曰：「諸佛無上妙道，愈求愈遠，轉覓轉疏。」士曰：「若不苦求，弟子不知。」師曰：「道不屬知，不屬不知。」士曰：「畢竟如何是道？」師曰：「道無畢竟，道無如何。」士曰：「如師之指示，越發摸索不著。」師曰：「你是大醫麼？」士曰：「不敢。」師曰：「甘草甜，黃連苦。」士曰：「這個弟子豈有不知？」師曰：「你特煞伶俐，道自遠矣。」一居士問：「如何是佛法大意？」師曰：「石頭土塊。」士曰：「此意如何？」師曰：「長江水上波。」士曰：「如何是長江水上波？」師曰：「險。」士無語。師曰：「者俗漢沒頭浸煞了也。」一居士問：「倩女離魂，那個是真？」師曰：「河裏失錢河裏摝。」一日，師下堂曰：「參禪須要大死一番始得。若要大死，捏起拳頭，挺起脊梁，看個話頭，看到沒滋味，沒撈摸，無天無地，無人無

Senses.Explanation: The royal decree has reached all under heaven; beyond the frontier the general has ended the dust of war brings an image of decisive authority into the teaching hall. The recorded Linji exchange gives it as the answer to a question about taking away setting but not person. Huijue closes his own sermon with the same image. Baishan uses it to answer a monk who asks about Nanchuan’s cat. Tianyi invokes the line after describing the reach of a staff’s action. Zhufeng gives it at the climax of a sermon on grasping and release. Dounan uses it as a direct answer to a question about the point immediately at hand.

Senses.Explanation: Attendant Wang is the lay official who appears in Linji Yixuan’s record as patron, visitor, and questioner. He requests Linji’s public address, visits the monks’ hall, and comments on cases before masters answer him. The title identifies Wang as a case participant; it does not make Linji the utterer of narrative sentences that introduce Wang.

Senses.Explanation: Royal law is the binding law of a ruler or realm. In the Fengxue case, an unnamed local administrator compares Buddha Dharma with royal law and invokes the danger of failing to decide. Yongjia Xuanjue lists royal law and prison among worldly hazards. Guxue Zhenzhe explicitly distinguishes royal law from Buddha Dharma and says that royal law punishes worldly offenders. A lamp biography gives the political sense concrete force when Huotang Yan refuses special treatment during legal proceedings and asks whether royal law recognizes old and young. The Chan comparisons use this ordinary legal meaning; they do not replace it.

Senses.Explanation: "The king ascends the jeweled hall; old villagers sing for joy" pictures a central action answered by an unforced public response. Linji gives it as an answer about person and surroundings; later masters turn it to appraisal and hall address. Linji answers the question about neither person nor surroundings being taken away with the paired image. Qianyan concludes a case appraisal with it; Dafang speaks it in an early morning address and then asks where a bodhisattva is. Jingting closes a ceremonial address for Prince Jian with the line and a question about gratitude.

Entries.SourceTerm: 王老師自小養一頭水牯牛

Senses.PreferredTarget: Old Master Wang has raised a water buffalo since it was young
SearchAliases: old master wang has raised a water buffalo since it was young
Senses.Note: Nanquan calls himself Old Master Wang and says he has raised a water buffalo since it was small. Grazing east or west of the stream would consume the ruler’s water and grass, so he offers a small payment. Miyun says he seeks what should already be his. Sanyi asks whether the payment is east or west; Daxiu describes a buffalo he neither sends east nor west. Yun’e faults Nanquan’s evasiveness, Tiebi sets blue and white buffaloes together, and Juelang says to graze openly without trampling another’s crop. The animal makes ownership and use a live question.

Senses.Explanation: Nanquan says he has long raised a water buffalo, then wonders where to graze it without using the ruler’s land. Miyun, Sanyi, and Daxiu quote the old buffalo and challenge Nanquan’s choice of pasture. Yun’e calls the compromise evasive, Tiebi offers another buffalo image, and Juelang proposes open grazing without harm.

Entries.SourceTerm: 王老師賣身去也，還有人買麼

Senses.PreferredTarget: Old Wang is selling himself; is there anyone who will buy?
AlternateTargets: Teacher Wang offers himself for sale: who is willing to buy?
SearchAliases: old Wang sells himself who will buy Nanquan Chan
Nanquan teacher Wang self sale buyer Zen
Senses.Note: Nanquan calls himself Old Wang and asks who will buy him. In the rest of the case a monk offers to buy, and Nanquan rules out both high and low pricing. Sanyi assesses Xuedou's response; Zhe'an challenges ordinary price-setting; Foyuan and Xiaotang test several older bids, and a later teacher gives a fresh answer about the sale contract. The exact opening line matters because the later bargaining problem begins with this offer.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 別云：「吾心似片光，大地露堂堂，處處堪比倫，分明誰覆藏？」代古代古舉：「僧謂趙州云：『某甲從長安來，橫一條拄杖，不曾撥著一人。』州云：『自是大德拄杖短。』僧無語。」代云：「某甲不意撥著一個瞎漢。」舉：「僧參趙州，州問：『甚處來？』僧云：『南方。』州云：『佛法盡在南方，汝來作麼？』僧云：『佛法豈有南北？』州云：『饒汝從雪峰、雲居來，也只是個擔板漢！』僧無語。」代云：「某甲罪過，卻被和尚道著。」舉：「洞山問德山侍者：『從何方來？』者云：『從德山來。』洞云：『來作什麼？』者云：『孝順和尚。』洞云：『世間什麼物最孝順？』者無對。」代云：「分明道過了也。」舉：「僧參聖壽嚴，嚴補衲次，提起云：『山僧一衲衣，展似眾人見，雲水請兩條，莫教露針線。快道！』僧無對。」代云：「針線早是已露了也，某甲道個什麼即得？」舉：「昔有老宿問座主：『疏鈔解義，廣略如何？』主云：『鈔解疏，疏解經。』宿云：『經解什麼？』主無對。」代云：「下文繁長。」舉：「南泉云：『王老師賣身去也，還有人買麼？』一僧出眾云：『某甲買。』泉云：『不作貴、不作賤，作麼生買？』僧無對。」代云：「和尚出賣，文約花押，早到某甲手裡了也。」舉：「鹽官一日喚侍者：『將犀牛扇子來。』者云：『破也。』官云：『扇子既破，還我犀牛兒來。』者無對。」代云：「震威一喝，鹽官他若動靜，便云：『縱有千般巧、終無兩樣風。』」舉：「楚石禪師入寮，見僧看經，問云：『看的什麼經？』僧云：『是《金剛經》。』石云：『我不問你《金剛經》，看底是什麼經？』僧無對。」代云：「意欲再道，猶恐頭上安頭。」舉：「僧問石霜：『咫尺之間，為甚不睹師顏？』霜云：『我道遍界不曾藏。』僧後問雪峰：『遍界不曾藏，意旨如何？』峰云：『什麼處不是石霜？』僧回，舉似霜，霜云：『這老漢著什麼死急？』僧無對。」代云：「情知和尚不藏，親見了也。」舉：「一僧在經堂內不看經，每日打坐，藏主云：『何不看經？』僧云：『某甲不識字。』主云：『何不問人？』僧近前叉手鞠躬云：『這個是什麼字？』主無對。」代云：「一腳踢倒，他若擬議，便云：『這個字也不識。』」頌古頌古世尊初於臘月八日明星出時，慧云：「奇哉！一切眾生俱有如來智慧德相，但以妄想執著，不能證得。」頌云：雪嶺六年也似貧，灰頭土面草生身，夜來忽睹明星現，夢破驚回識故

Senses.PreferredTarget: The ruler's word begins as a thread and comes forth as a cord
SearchAliases: the ruler's word begins as a thread and comes forth as a cord
Senses.Note: A ruler's word is compared to a fine thread that becomes a thick cord once issued. Yinyuan applies that expansion to his New Year address. Xieyun cites the classic while reflecting on a master's words; Shanduo uses it to judge a case answer. Baishan gives it as the reply to a question about establishing the world, and Wuyi turns it on Fayan's repeated statement. The image tests the reach of a word in context.

Wansong uses the solitary-rider image in his own introductory warning to a case on the Buddha pointing to the ground.

Senses.Explanation: The phrase pictures one rider entering combat with one spear. Verse appraisals use the battle image for direct encounter, while monks make it the premise of challenge questions. Baoning Renyong uses the single-spear battle in verse on the Linji encounter. Sixin invites a solitary challenger into a present hall encounter; Wansong uses the same battle image in a separate case introduction. Retained public meaning is supported by independent present uses in recorded discourse.

Senses.PreferredTarget: See it without seizing it, and it will not be forgotten for a thousand years
AlternateTargets: What is seen without being grasped remains unforgettable for ages
SearchAliases: seen not taken thousand years hard to forget
Senses.Note: The pair joins seeing something to a refusal to take or hold it, then says that the sight is hard to forget even across a thousand years. In the recorded uses this is a prompt at a visible or spoken encounter: Liao’an and Songyuan raise an object before their audiences; Binya answers a monk; Azi and Shuzhong close addresses; Chushi tests a familiar case. The phrase concerns grasping at what is seen, not a promise of literal thousand-year memory.

Occurrences.Kwic: 。人人具移丘塞壑之手、箇箇抱屠龍陷虎之機，摩肩輻輳，一字排來，到得海幢門下，未是海幢深深處。大眾！還信麼？待拄杖子把一干老凍膿略放一線，使他腳踏實地，與他平實商量，箇箇志氣充足，好於明晨新年上殿祝聖，揖客陪茶。」復卓拄杖，云：「大眾！還見麼？貴買不如賤賣。」辛亥元日，上堂。師云：「金烏爍破海門東，三百六十自今始，計其住此已十年，吉祥如意從頭起。」卓拄杖，云：「從頭起，明珠一粒大如盤，十箇阿師舁不起，乘風直上睹史天，彌勒門開樓閣峙。過去佛、現在佛、未來佛摩肩而坐，聲聞乘、圓覺乘、菩薩乘並足而侍，忘語默而寶繒飛揚，絕見聞而天花亂墜。補處菩薩於白毫相光放音聲輪，說有、說空、說非有非空、說即有即空，乃至指賴耶為如來藏心，滅證自證分而無白淨之體，圓融即在行布，因果灼爾同時，種種方便一周佛事，不消海幢拄杖子一卓百雜碎。大眾！為甚麼如此？以非諸佛之境界。既非諸佛之境界，亦非衲僧之境界。境界俱非，且道海幢今年新年頭佛法作麼生舉揚？」良久，云：「見之不取，千載難忘。」辛亥七月大盡，上堂。師云：「海幢有一則公案，非今、非古，非新、非故，非大、非小，非有、非無。放行，則氣逼虛空；抱住，則針藏錦縫。三冬揮汗，十年不識春秋；九夏飛霜，一虫莫辨寒暑。所以，阿上座於此地固一半祖禰不了，亦一半靜中流溢，遂與現前諸職十載提挈，雖得四稜蹋地，也被他移換不少。縱饒朱甍映水，鮫室燦錦城之霞；清磬臨江，蜃樓響魚山之梵。飛空一翳，境物樅然。更說於明晨要與殿中三世如來開甚麼光明？勞各山諸師、社中居士特特遠來，重煩省會藩王與文武諸大宰護光駐慶揚。大眾！且道如何是佛光？佛光又作麼生開？金佛不度爐，木佛不度火，坭佛不度水，真佛裏面坐。若識得真佛，不唯與殿中三世如來開光，且十方諸佛菩薩一齊開光，一切賢聖、尊卑、僧俗、男女、童叟亦一齊開光。一切諸佛菩薩有如是福德、智慧、壽命、莊嚴，一切賢聖、尊卑、僧俗、男女童叟亦有如是福德智慧、壽命莊嚴。大眾還知麼？」以拂子一拂，云：「大鵬展翅蓋十洲，籬邊之物空啾啾，乘獅跨象且過一邊，說聖道凡亦且坐地，度水星娥漫勞歲月，乘槎俗子早入斗牛，朱砂燒盡不見金丹，白玉鋤來總非頑石，拓開千頃軟琉璃，更莫從新討水喫。此事如打流星相似，一步旋一步闊，若是從上相承有少渣滓，便是佛法不靈。不見道：『尊貴一

Occurrences.Kwic: 法匡宗媿昔賢，今日盡情都放下，話頭不舉自完全。大丈夫漢終不向淨潔地上坐殺，蓋其自有透脫一路。所以道：去來不以像，動靜不以心，塵塵普入，剎剎全彰。正與麼時，且臨歧一句作麼生道？擕取詩書歸舊隱，野華啼鳥一般春。恕中和尚語錄卷第一恕中和尚語錄卷第二處州府南明禪寺住持嗣法比丘道瑄等編住黃巖瑞巖淨土禪寺語錄住黃巖瑞巖淨土禪寺語錄山門盡大地是解脫門，把手拽不入。雪峯與麼道，瑞巖不與麼道。喝一喝。佛殿。佛是家裏人，直下會得玄沙道底。土地堂，虗靈寂照，固不在言。飯籮邊，漆桶裏，有一句子還知麼？蘇嚧蘇嚧。祖堂。心心相同，眼眼相矚。一等陳年爛葛藤，六六依然三十六。據室，我者裏一切只是尋常，你若來弄機關，誇敏手，向毒蛇頭上揩癢，猛虎頷下解鈴，拄杖子未打你在。何故？有盤根錯節方可施利器，有銀山鐵壁方可展鉗槌。拈明州三宗諸山䟽。祖意教意，是同是別。風清三佛地，月朗四明山。法座。平地上險崖，孤峻處平易，是古今尋常用底，今日終不向者裏依模脫墼瞞汝諸人。雖然，見之不取，千載難忘。且坐斷毗盧頂頭一句作麼生道？眾無語，乃云：洎合放過。便登座。祝聖罷，次拈香云：此香已是第二回拈出，爇向爐中，供養我前住崑山薦嚴禪寺、晚年歸老紫籜峯頭西方廣院竺元大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。然冤家債主自有來由，今日幸對人天眾前，不妨重為洗雪一上。山僧昔年在彼山中咨參者箇老和尚，為看狗子無佛性話不破，特去請益。纔開口，被他一喝，直得通身汗下，因進呈一頌云：狗子佛性無，春色滿皇都，趙州東院裏，壁上掛葫蘆。乃發笑曰：恁麼會又爭得？可謂前箭猶輕後箭深。插香云：縱有伯牙琴，應難寫心曲。遂斂衣就座。廣孝和尚白槌云：法筵龍象眾，當觀第一義。師垂語云：諸佛出世是第二頭，祖師西來是第三首，饒你向威音那畔別立生涯，百草頭邊全明殺活，布袋裏老鴉子未知有出身一路在。作麼生是出身一路？師乃云：今日無人出問話，不是冷落門𨓍，正是光顯門𨓍。何也？若論此事，實不在語言上；若在語言上，釋迦世尊四十九年說一大藏，之乎者也，豈是無言耶？因甚末後向靈山百萬眾前單單拈起一枝華，惟迦葉一人打頭知尾，驀爾破顏微笑？既是物直貨當，便云：吾有正法眼藏分付摩訶大迦葉。由此󲋼相傳授而至于今，當時豈有攢華簇錦、辯舌利辭，問一句來、答一句去，湊得團欒、合得恰好，然後始相付囑？惜乎！者老漢

Occurrences.Kwic: 雪峯。生死海無邊，不知誰解度。覆船一句子，截斷兩條路。雪竇老徒嘮嘮，我王庫內無如是刀。舉，僧問雲門：如何是一代時教？門云：對一說。訝郎當，對一說，膠柱調絃，掉棒打月。出頭天外是何人，鼻孔依前搭上唇。舉，僧問雲門：不是目前機，亦非目前事時如何？門云：倒一說。誰當機，倒一說，七縱八橫，千差萬別。石田喚起土牛耕，無種靈苗徧界生。舉溈山問仰山云：天寒人寒？仰云：大家在這裏。溈云：何不直說？仰云：適來也不曲，和尚如何？溈云：且須隨流。溈山仰山，天寒人寒，隨流一句，萬種千般。盤走珠，珠走盤，憑君子細好生觀。不增不減金剛體，無聖無凡赤肉團。舉世尊於一處九旬安居，至自恣日，文殊倐來。迦葉問：今夏在何處安居？文殊云：在三處安居。迦葉於是白眾，欲擯文殊出。纔舉犍槌，乃見無量佛剎，一一佛所有一一文殊，一一迦葉舉槌欲擯之。世尊於是告迦葉云：汝今欲擯出那箇文殊？唯一文殊，無二文殊，百千萬億，徧滿塵區。可惜飲光尊者當時蹉過了也。既然舉起槌來，何不便揮一下？見之不取，千載難忘，總是喪車後藥囊。舉巖頭示眾云：涅槃經道：吾教意如塗毒鼓，擊著遠近，聞者皆喪。僧問：如何是塗毒鼓？頭亞身云：韓信臨朝底。塗毒鼓，聞者喪，多少死人平地上。死中得活是非常，堪與叢林作榜樣。韓信臨朝知不知，突出當陽舉話時。舉，文殊問菴提遮女：生以何為義？女云：生以不生生為生義。殊云：如何是生以不生生為生義？女云：若能明知地、水、火、風四緣未曾自得，有所和合，而能隨其所宜以為生義。殊云：死以何為義？女云：死以不死死為死義。殊云：如何是死以不死死為死義？女云：若能明知地、水、火、風四緣未曾自得，有所離散，而能隨其所宜以為死義。生以不生生為生，冬瓜掛在胡蘆棚；死以不死死為死，蟭螟眼中放夜市。和合離散，各隨所宜。畢竟他是阿誰？舉歸宗示眾云：吾今欲說禪，諸子總近前。大眾進前，宗云：汝聽觀音行，善應諸方所。僧問：如何是觀音行？宗彈指云：諸人聞麼？僧云：聞。宗云：一隊漢向這裏覔箇什麼？以拄杖打趂，呵呵大笑，歸方丈。歸宗一彈指，剎剎塵塵從定起。眼裏著得百千萬億須彌山，耳裏著得不可思議大海水。觀音行，何可擬，少林謾說分皮髓。佛日普照慧辯楚石禪師語錄卷第十二音切胤舷閫撞挾複鋒鋩勦斸咄噓覿牯蔓崢嶸悄瀏醯甎墼逞驤翛絛錘鋤馭扭刈麈󳬢懊妍𡟎陂鯨鯢蛙佇󰕖糝倐佛

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 大闡玄猷，文殊三處度夏，懶安一向牧牛，蹈破脚版，拽脫鼻頭。且畢竟發明箇甚麼邊事？卓拄杖，云：釣竿斫盡重栽竹，不計功程得便休。復舉文殊三處度夏機緣，師頌云：正令當行下一椎，從教徧界是文殊。驚群須是英靈漢，敵勝還他師子兒。上堂，拈拄杖云：與麼來者，彩鳳舞丹霄；不與麼來者，鐵蛇橫古路。直饒與麼、不與麼，去來道絕，也是秤錘蘸醋。卓拄杖，下座。上堂。大用現前，不存途轍。要默即默，要說即說。指鹿為馬，喚日作月。臨濟德山，只一得橛。喝一喝。僧相看，師問云：甚處來？僧云：廬山。師云：五老峯頭白也未？僧云：白也。師云：年多少？僧無語。師云：你豈不是廬山來？僧云：是。師便打出。上堂：十五日已前，水向石邊流出冷。十五日已後，風從花裡過來香。正當十五日火後，一莖茅鐵蛇鑽不入。喝一喝。臘八，上堂。萬法是心光，諸緣惟性曉。本無迷悟人，只要今日了。咄哉老瞿曇，討甚閑煩惱。出山與入山，自起還自倒。夜來斗轉玉繩橫，不覺全身墮荒草。喝一喝。上堂，舉拂子云：還見麼？見之不取，千載難忘。取則不無，作麼生說箇見底道理？莫是有見見麼？莫是無見見麼？莫是不有不無見見麼？莫是不不有不不無見見麼？若也與麼，要作他座主奴也未得在。所以道：了了見，無一物，亦無人，亦無佛，大千沙界海中漚，一切聖賢如電拂。好諸禪德！稜道者坐破七箇蒲團，末後於卷簾處驀然見得，便道：也大差！也大差！卷起簾來見天下，有人問我解何宗？拈起拂子劈口打。是他古人不妨性躁、不妨快活。若約撿點將來，者拂子合是稜道者自喫始得。何故？太平只許將軍致，不許將軍見太平。上堂：拈一放一，本分宗師。蓋地蓋天，罕逢作者。刁刀相似，魚魯參差。任是鶻眼龍睛，未免錯認驢鞍橋作阿爺下頷。喝一喝，歸堂喫茶。上堂。釋迦拈花，飲光微笑。達磨面壁，二祖安心。驀拈拄杖卓一下，云：白雲為蓋，流泉作琴。一曲兩曲無人會，雨過野塘春水深。擲下拄杖，下座。上堂，僧問：單傳直指，已涉離微，坐斷千差，請師答話。師云：破鏡不重照，落花難上枝。進云：豈無方便？師云：烏龜鑽敗壁。師乃云：單傳直指，正涉離微，坐斷千差，開眼落井。拈拄杖卓一下：烏龜鑽敗壁，雞向五更啼。上堂。兜率悅和尚云：撥草瞻風，只圖見性。即今上人性在甚處？識得自性，方脫生死。眼光落地時作麼生脫？脫得生死，便知去處。四大分離向什麼處去好？大眾

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 寺語錄參學善開光睦等錄指三門，云：君山有路，到者還稀；解脫無門，從何而入？喝一喝，云：一盲引眾盲。入佛殿燒香，云：德山拆了佛殿，忍俊不禁；雲門打與狗喫，未為分外。岳上座到來，一時坐斷，要且和光同塵，從教黃面老子自然腦門著地。據坐方丈，云：太虗挂劒全生殺，星馳電卷煙雲豁。可中誰是出頭人？長嘯一聲天地闊。上堂，僧問：無邊剎境毫端見，不涉程途已到家。如何是到家底句？答云：月似彎弓，少雨多風。進云：不是玉堂人具眼，未應容易到君山。答云：我行荒艸裏，汝又入深村。進云：謝師答話。師便喝，僧禮拜。師乃舉：保壽開堂，三聖推出一僧，保壽便打。三聖道：與麼為人，瞎却鎮州一城人眼去在。保壽擲下拄杖，歸方丈。師云：大凡扶豎宗乘，須具頂門正眼，懸肘後靈符。二尊宿等閑一挨一拶，便乃發明臨際心髓，只是不知性命總在這僧手裏。還有人檢點得出麼？昔年覓火和煙得，今日擔泉帶月歸。上堂，橫按拄杖，云：彌勒真彌勒，分身千百億，時時示時人，時人皆不識。是汝諸人還識得也未？見之不取，千載難忘。遂擲拄杖，下座。上堂。邪人說正法，正法悉皆邪；正人說邪法，邪法悉皆正。驀拈拄杖卓一下，云：這裏是什麼所在，說邪說正？雖然，笑我者多，哂我者少。遂靠拄杖，下座。上堂。殺人刀．活人劒，上古之風規，今時之樞要。古人恁麼道，太煞小膽。山僧百醜千拙，波波挈挈，也無殺人刀．活人劒，只是當時行脚不著，便踏碎一箇破砂盆，直至而今収不得。眾中莫有収得者麼？喝一喝。上堂：有利無利，不離行市。張公喫酒李公醉，伸脚打睡有來由，纔放醒醒成忌諱。非不非，是不是，遇貴即賤，遇賤即貴。狸奴白牯念摩訶，祖師不會西來意。四月八日，上堂。拈拄杖云：黃面老子下生也，即今在拄杖頭上，一手指天，一手指地，云：天上天下，唯吾獨尊。諸人還見麼？若道見，被拄杖子熱瞞；若道不見，諸人自瞞。靠拄杖，下座。上堂：月旦曰朔，月圓曰望，八字打開，有収有放。薩怛阿竭二千年前摩醯首羅頂門正眼覿面，提持生鐵門限，俊底撩起便行，漆桶一任擔板。上堂，拈拄杖橫按，云：一不成，二不是，突出眼睛失却鼻。少林剛自覓安心，瞎驢不受靈山記。上堂，舉：南泉和尚云：王老師自小養得一頭水牯牛，擬向溪東放，不免食他國王水艸；擬向溪西放，不免食他國王水艸。不如隨分納些些，總不見得。師云：王老師傾腸倒腹即不無，未見

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 。人人具移丘塞壑之手、箇箇抱屠龍陷虎之機，摩肩輻輳，一字排來，到得海幢門下，未是海幢深深處。大眾！還信麼？待拄杖子把一干老凍膿略放一線，使他腳踏實地，與他平實商量，箇箇志氣充足，好於明晨新年上殿祝聖，揖客陪茶。」復卓拄杖，云：「大眾！還見麼？貴買不如賤賣。」辛亥元日，上堂。師云：「金烏爍破海門東，三百六十自今始，計其住此已十年，吉祥如意從頭起。」卓拄杖，云：「從頭起，明珠一粒大如盤，十箇阿師舁不起，乘風直上睹史天，彌勒門開樓閣峙。過去佛、現在佛、未來佛摩肩而坐，聲聞乘、圓覺乘、菩薩乘並足而侍，忘語默而寶繒飛揚，絕見聞而天花亂墜。補處菩薩於白毫相光放音聲輪，說有、說空、說非有非空、說即有即空，乃至指賴耶為如來藏心，滅證自證分而無白淨之體，圓融即在行布，因果灼爾同時，種種方便一周佛事，不消海幢拄杖子一卓百雜碎。大眾！為甚麼如此？以非諸佛之境界。既非諸佛之境界，亦非衲僧之境界。境界俱非，且道海幢今年新年頭佛法作麼生舉揚？」良久，云：「見之不取，千載難忘。」辛亥七月大盡，上堂。師云：「海幢有一則公案，非今、非古，非新、非故，非大、非小，非有、非無。放行，則氣逼虛空；抱住，則針藏錦縫。三冬揮汗，十年不識春秋；九夏飛霜，一虫莫辨寒暑。所以，阿上座於此地固一半祖禰不了，亦一半靜中流溢，遂與現前諸職十載提挈，雖得四稜蹋地，也被他移換不少。縱饒朱甍映水，鮫室燦錦城之霞；清磬臨江，蜃樓響魚山之梵。飛空一翳，境物樅然。更說於明晨要與殿中三世如來開甚麼光明？勞各山諸師、社中居士特特遠來，重煩省會藩王與文武諸大宰護光駐慶揚。大眾！且道如何是佛光？佛光又作麼生開？金佛不度爐，木佛不度火，坭佛不度水，真佛裏面坐。若識得真佛，不唯與殿中三世如來開光，且十方諸佛菩薩一齊開光，一切賢聖、尊卑、僧俗、男女、童叟亦一齊開光。一切諸佛菩薩有如是福德、智慧、壽命、莊嚴，一切賢聖、尊卑、僧俗、男女童叟亦有如是福德智慧、壽命莊嚴。大眾還知麼？」以拂子一拂，云：「大鵬展翅蓋十洲，籬邊之物空啾啾，乘獅跨象且過一邊，說聖道凡亦且坐地，度水星娥漫勞歲月，乘槎俗子早入斗牛，朱砂燒盡不見金丹，白玉鋤來總非頑石，拓開千頃軟琉璃，更莫從新討水喫。此事如打流星相似，一步旋一步闊，若是從上相承有少渣滓，便是佛法不靈。不見道：『尊貴一

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 法匡宗媿昔賢，今日盡情都放下，話頭不舉自完全。大丈夫漢終不向淨潔地上坐殺，蓋其自有透脫一路。所以道：去來不以像，動靜不以心，塵塵普入，剎剎全彰。正與麼時，且臨歧一句作麼生道？擕取詩書歸舊隱，野華啼鳥一般春。恕中和尚語錄卷第一恕中和尚語錄卷第二處州府南明禪寺住持嗣法比丘道瑄等編住黃巖瑞巖淨土禪寺語錄住黃巖瑞巖淨土禪寺語錄山門盡大地是解脫門，把手拽不入。雪峯與麼道，瑞巖不與麼道。喝一喝。佛殿。佛是家裏人，直下會得玄沙道底。土地堂，虗靈寂照，固不在言。飯籮邊，漆桶裏，有一句子還知麼？蘇嚧蘇嚧。祖堂。心心相同，眼眼相矚。一等陳年爛葛藤，六六依然三十六。據室，我者裏一切只是尋常，你若來弄機關，誇敏手，向毒蛇頭上揩癢，猛虎頷下解鈴，拄杖子未打你在。何故？有盤根錯節方可施利器，有銀山鐵壁方可展鉗槌。拈明州三宗諸山䟽。祖意教意，是同是別。風清三佛地，月朗四明山。法座。平地上險崖，孤峻處平易，是古今尋常用底，今日終不向者裏依模脫墼瞞汝諸人。雖然，見之不取，千載難忘。且坐斷毗盧頂頭一句作麼生道？眾無語，乃云：洎合放過。便登座。祝聖罷，次拈香云：此香已是第二回拈出，爇向爐中，供養我前住崑山薦嚴禪寺、晚年歸老紫籜峯頭西方廣院竺元大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。然冤家債主自有來由，今日幸對人天眾前，不妨重為洗雪一上。山僧昔年在彼山中咨參者箇老和尚，為看狗子無佛性話不破，特去請益。纔開口，被他一喝，直得通身汗下，因進呈一頌云：狗子佛性無，春色滿皇都，趙州東院裏，壁上掛葫蘆。乃發笑曰：恁麼會又爭得？可謂前箭猶輕後箭深。插香云：縱有伯牙琴，應難寫心曲。遂斂衣就座。廣孝和尚白槌云：法筵龍象眾，當觀第一義。師垂語云：諸佛出世是第二頭，祖師西來是第三首，饒你向威音那畔別立生涯，百草頭邊全明殺活，布袋裏老鴉子未知有出身一路在。作麼生是出身一路？師乃云：今日無人出問話，不是冷落門𨓍，正是光顯門𨓍。何也？若論此事，實不在語言上；若在語言上，釋迦世尊四十九年說一大藏，之乎者也，豈是無言耶？因甚末後向靈山百萬眾前單單拈起一枝華，惟迦葉一人打頭知尾，驀爾破顏微笑？既是物直貨當，便云：吾有正法眼藏分付摩訶大迦葉。由此󲋼相傳授而至于今，當時豈有攢華簇錦、辯舌利辭，問一句來、答一句去，湊得團欒、合得恰好，然後始相付囑？惜乎！者老漢

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 雪峯。生死海無邊，不知誰解度。覆船一句子，截斷兩條路。雪竇老徒嘮嘮，我王庫內無如是刀。舉，僧問雲門：如何是一代時教？門云：對一說。訝郎當，對一說，膠柱調絃，掉棒打月。出頭天外是何人，鼻孔依前搭上唇。舉，僧問雲門：不是目前機，亦非目前事時如何？門云：倒一說。誰當機，倒一說，七縱八橫，千差萬別。石田喚起土牛耕，無種靈苗徧界生。舉溈山問仰山云：天寒人寒？仰云：大家在這裏。溈云：何不直說？仰云：適來也不曲，和尚如何？溈云：且須隨流。溈山仰山，天寒人寒，隨流一句，萬種千般。盤走珠，珠走盤，憑君子細好生觀。不增不減金剛體，無聖無凡赤肉團。舉世尊於一處九旬安居，至自恣日，文殊倐來。迦葉問：今夏在何處安居？文殊云：在三處安居。迦葉於是白眾，欲擯文殊出。纔舉犍槌，乃見無量佛剎，一一佛所有一一文殊，一一迦葉舉槌欲擯之。世尊於是告迦葉云：汝今欲擯出那箇文殊？唯一文殊，無二文殊，百千萬億，徧滿塵區。可惜飲光尊者當時蹉過了也。既然舉起槌來，何不便揮一下？見之不取，千載難忘，總是喪車後藥囊。舉巖頭示眾云：涅槃經道：吾教意如塗毒鼓，擊著遠近，聞者皆喪。僧問：如何是塗毒鼓？頭亞身云：韓信臨朝底。塗毒鼓，聞者喪，多少死人平地上。死中得活是非常，堪與叢林作榜樣。韓信臨朝知不知，突出當陽舉話時。舉，文殊問菴提遮女：生以何為義？女云：生以不生生為生義。殊云：如何是生以不生生為生義？女云：若能明知地、水、火、風四緣未曾自得，有所和合，而能隨其所宜以為生義。殊云：死以何為義？女云：死以不死死為死義。殊云：如何是死以不死死為死義？女云：若能明知地、水、火、風四緣未曾自得，有所離散，而能隨其所宜以為死義。生以不生生為生，冬瓜掛在胡蘆棚；死以不死死為死，蟭螟眼中放夜市。和合離散，各隨所宜。畢竟他是阿誰？舉歸宗示眾云：吾今欲說禪，諸子總近前。大眾進前，宗云：汝聽觀音行，善應諸方所。僧問：如何是觀音行？宗彈指云：諸人聞麼？僧云：聞。宗云：一隊漢向這裏覔箇什麼？以拄杖打趂，呵呵大笑，歸方丈。歸宗一彈指，剎剎塵塵從定起。眼裏著得百千萬億須彌山，耳裏著得不可思議大海水。觀音行，何可擬，少林謾說分皮髓。佛日普照慧辯楚石禪師語錄卷第十二音切胤舷閫撞挾複鋒鋩勦斸咄噓覿牯蔓崢嶸悄瀏醯甎墼逞驤翛絛錘鋤馭扭刈麈󳬢懊妍𡟎陂鯨鯢蛙佇󰕖糝倐佛

Senses.Explanation: A sight can be clear without being seized as something to own. Liao’an raises his whisk and Songyuan raises a staff before using the pair; both make “seeing” a present event for the assembly. Binya gives it as an answer to a monk, while Azi closes a New Year address with it. Shuzhong uses it while speaking at the seat, and Chushi applies it to a teaching story he is examining.

Senses.PreferredTarget: failing to take what is seen before thought puts it a thousand miles away
AlternateTargets: do not seize the immediate; thought makes it remote

Senses.Explanation: The warning says that what is immediately seen goes untaken; once thought begins, it is already a thousand miles away. Huanglong concludes a gold-and-sand test with the warning; a small talk repeats that discernment test; a Dajue evening address applies it to household treasure; Tianru gives it as an encounter answer.

Senses.Explanation: “Release the hawk on seeing a rabbit” (見兔放鷹) names an action timed to the appearance of its quarry. Xidun Chao applies it to the estate-owner case and pairs the other participant with “following an error with an error.” Yuanwu places it between “raise one and illuminate three” and “use the wind to fan the fire.” In Xuefeng Sihui’s hall address it stands beside releasing an arrow on meeting a muntjac; Fohai calls it ordinary use alongside returning an ox for a horse; Dongchan Yue contrasts it with static repetition. The phrase therefore occurs as an appraisal of responsive action, not as falconry narrative.

Senses.Note: Longtan says his teacher has never shown him the essential teaching. Tianhuang lists how he received Longtan’s tea, food, and bows, then says that direct seeing should not wait on thought. Longtan understands. Hengxiulin retells the encounter and says he would answer with a blow. Baiyun composes a verse on the ordinary acts, and Yongjue cites the exchange while arguing that Longtan studied with Tianhuang rather than Tianwang. The sentence points back to what was already happening between teacher and student.

Senses.Explanation: To see one's own nature. Chan records place this claim in transmission formulas, instructions, questions, and explicit challenges. Hongren links it with directly becoming a buddha; a text attributed to Bodhidharma says that seeking a buddha requires it. Huangbo Xiyun answers a direct question by refusing to make nature a second object seen by a separate seeing subject. Dahui Zonggao repeats that it is required for an unerring road and immediately asks which mind recognizes and which nature is seen. Zhongfeng Mingben says direct pointing is no longer direct once it enters speech or contrivance, while Yongming Yanshou says that once nature is seen, mind and the teaching remedies both cease. The phrase names a claimed recognition, but the records repeatedly test what the grammar of a seer looking at a separate nature would wrongly add.

Senses.Explanation: The faculty or nature of seeing, a noun phrase rather than the action of seeing one's own nature. Hanyue Fazang and Bore Gulin each quote an outside claimant who treats this seeing faculty as an unchanging witness that survives the destruction of a visible tile or stove; both speakers identify that claim as an error. Huanyou Zhengchuan groups the phrase with the nature of hearing and the nature of awareness, then says seeing and nature are not two separately visible things. This distinct segmentation matters because translating these passages as an achievement of seeing one's nature would reverse their grammar and hide the criticism.

Senses.Explanation: Seeing the situation and changing accordingly names responsive adjustment, but the records immediately test whether that adjustment is complete. Xuedou Chongxian grants the turn and then faults it for having a head without a tail; Hongzhi Zhengjue uses failure to change as a criticism of the interlocutor's response. In the bell case, the questioned participant runs when told to strike the bell. Xuedou calls that a change made on seeing the situation but says it lacks completion. Hongzhi's Zhaozhou comment uses the negative form, saying the interlocutor could not change with the situation.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 請諸人證據。驀拈拄杖，卓一下，云：新年把筆，萬事大吉。靠拄杖，下座。師問僧云：盡十方世界是毗盧正印，你道印紐落在什麼人手裏？僧擬議，師厲聲云：且去，別時來。上堂，舉：古德云：有一人常在途中，不離家舍；有一人離家舍，不在途中。且道那一人合受人天供養？師云：離家舍、不離家舍，在途中、不在途中即不論，徑山道：盡大地止有一人合受人天供養。諸人還識那一人麼？擊拂子：莫教開却眼，󳬧子過新羅。上堂。三世諸佛也與麼，六代祖師也與麼，天下老和尚也只與麼，獨有徑山却不與麼。你道與麼不與麼還有優劣也無？拈拄杖畫一畫，云：一二三四五六七，七六五四三二一，昨夜三更月到窻，文殊坐對維摩詰。便下座。藥監寺火，應病與藥。據欵結按：金剛圈，栗棘蓬，透不過，吞不下，摠是死漢。山前猛虎趂於菟，火裏蝍蟟吞鼈鼻。上堂，舉：盤山和尚云：心月孤圓，光吞萬像。光非照境，境亦非存。光境俱忘，復是何物？洞山和尚云：光境未忘，復是何物？師云：二尊宿弄物不知名，各與二十拄杖。不見道：見義不為，何勇之有？芥室和尚忌，拈香云：巴陵三轉語，太殺誇張；楊岐女人拜，徒勞賣弄。徑山今日爇此枯木，不是供養先師，只要天下衲僧知有些子氣息。遂插香，召大眾云：且道是甚氣息？眾無語，師哭云：蒼天！蒼天！上堂：顛倒想滅，生死路絕。生死路絕，涅槃界空。洞山五位，臨濟三玄，擬向甚處安著？朝悠悠，暮悠悠，欲窮千里目，更上一層樓。拍禪床，下座。上堂。古人說不到處，今人說得到；今人行不到處，古人行得到。要知行不到處，便是說不到處；要知說得到處，便是行得到處。古人、今人鼻孔摠在徑山拄杖頭上，諸方老宿作麼拈掇？現前大眾作麼拈掇？拈拄杖，卓一下，便下座。冬至，上堂。舉：洞山冬夜與泰首座喫果子次，問云：有一物，明如日，黑如漆，常在動用中，動用中收不得，過在甚麼處？座云：過在動用中。洞山令侍者掇退果卓，泰首座不得果子吃。師拈云：當斷不斷，反招其亂。若是徑山見他道：過在甚麼處？便與掀翻果卓，亦使洞山知有宗門向上爪牙，今日兒孫不致寂寥。雖然，也須脚踏實地始得。拈拄杖：不向藍田射石虎，何人知是李將軍？卓拄杖，下座。上堂：祖師心印，狀似鉄牛之機。搆得搆不得即不問，你道祖師開口，舌頭落在甚麼處？擊拂子：不是一番寒徹骨，爭得梅花撲鼻香？上堂，舉：古德因僧問：如何是新年頭佛法？

ClaimAnchors.ClaimText: 見義不為，何勇之有

Senses.Explanation: A familiar maxim reproaches someone who sees the right course but hesitates. Dai’an uses it after judging an old case; Yikui opens a year-end talk with it to challenge his monks. Xiaotang applies it to seizing a staff, and Azi voices it after striking his staff in a sermon.

Entries.SourceTerm: 見義不為非勇士，臨危不變始驚群

Senses.PreferredTarget: One who sees what is right and fails to act is no brave person; one who stands unshaken in danger stands out from the crowd
AlternateTargets: Courage acts on the right and remains steady when danger comes
SearchAliases: acting on what is right steady in danger
Senses.Note: Poshan explicitly cites the couplet as an old saying, with its earlier speaker unidentified, and applies it to a military layman. Lianyue, Shengke, Hengxiulin, Yikui, and Xianglin voice it in their own present comments on Chan encounters. The courage here is a capacity to respond decisively, including under rebuke or danger; it does not prescribe violence.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 露地白牛、林野奇法叔煮透海烏雞，二老為人可謂豐且美矣，但叢林中不可損傷物命、賣弄腥羶，遭人檢點。幸而華巖者裏也無白牛烹、也無烏雞煮，但只隨緣消舊業，任運著衣裳，逢茶飲茶、遇飯喫飯。只此分歲，且道：與他二老是同？是別？萬國醉心嘗大鼎，相逢攜手蹈高臺。」晚參。「心隨萬境轉，轉處實能幽，隨流認得性，無喜亦無憂。河下篩鑼擂鼓、寺前犬吠驢鳴，客船上打寬、神廟中唱戲，字冰塗山、燈籠露柱，俱皆是境。心如何隨？境如何轉？性如何認？」時有僧云：「謝茶。」師云：「鞏縣。」僧不語，師云：「認得底，許你無憂；認不得底，莫道無憂好。」晚參。舉：「慈明參汾陽，陽揣其志，必詬罵。明一日請益，汾陽以杖逐之，明擬申救，汾陽以手掩明口，明大悟，云：『今日始知臨濟道出常情。』」師云：「華岩習氣不除，敢私淑古人？爾等若向老僧上堂、小參、入室、考工、晚參時，識得此人，只具一隻眼；若要雙眼圓明，須是向老僧痛打痛罵時識取。若也飲氣吞聲，又非丈夫覿體承當，難為湊泊。畢竟如何？見義不為非勇士，臨危不變始驚群。」晚參。舉：「香嚴道：『此事如人上樹，手不攀枝、足不蹋枝、口啣樹枝，有問祖師西來意，不答違問、答則失命。答底是？不答底是？』」眾無語。師乃云：「當時香嚴恁麼問時，會中有箇虎頭上座出來道：『樹上即不問，即今未上樹，請和尚道。』香嚴呵呵大笑。後雪竇舉云：『樹上道則易，樹下道則難，老僧上樹去也，致將一問來。』香嚴他參活句，不參死句，等閒立箇問端，只是險絕無比。虎頭、雪竇二俱作家，一箇上樹了下不得、一箇下樹了上不得，所以望影猶難，要見香嚴亦未可在。今日華岩與諸人別恣一路，要與香嚴同一鼻孔出氣。」遂吐舌云：「會麼？殊不知：人人口內啣一樹枝，放之不下、拈之不起，吞之不得、吐之不得，日用動靜、開口閉口、穿衣喫飯、行住坐臥，皆是喪身失命處，只因不覺，所以命根不斷耳。還見香嚴為人處也無？欸乃一聲船子曲，善歌漁父和難齊。」復頌云：「香嚴用活句，捨身命為人。虎頭與雪竇，樹枝未黏唇。」晚參。舉：「楊岐依石霜總院事甚久。一日霜出，雨忽作，岐偵之小徑，既見。著語云：『捉得賊了也。』又云：『好面孔。』遂搊住云：『者老漢須與我說，不說打你去。』著云：『贓物現在。』又云：『有理難伸。』霜云：『監寺知是般事便休。』著云：『詣實通供。』又云：『將錯就錯。』語未

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 」師云：「怎怪得山僧？」士云：「豈無方便？」師云：「隨緣消舊業，更莫造新殃。」問：「如何是玄要意旨？」師云：「併卻咽喉脣吻問將來。」進云：「學人併卻了也。如何是第一玄？」師云：「接竹點青天。」進云：「如何是第二玄？」師云：「空裏打鞦韆。」進云：「如何是第三玄？」師云：「藕絲繫鐵船。」進云：「如何是第一要？」師云：「饑來喫飯。」進云：「如何是第二要？」師云：「寒來著襖。」進云：「如何是第三要？」師云：「寒山逢拾得，撫掌呵呵笑。」進云：「玄要已蒙師指示，廬陵米價事如何？」師云：「逢貴即賤。」問：「如何是火裏栽蓮？」師云：「則今便請。」云：「恰遇和尚？」師云：「可知禮也。」乃云：「三界無安，猶如火宅。」驀豎拂子云：「大眾見麼？若也見得徹去，變穢邦而成淨土、轉火宅而為清涼，處一塵而一塵不能移其質、歷萬劫而萬劫不能易其長，可謂心同虛空界、量等虛空壽，無生亦無滅、無解亦無結，淨裸裸脫塵情、赤灑灑絕蓋覆，直得千聖同躔、萬機頓赴。還有恁麼人麼？見義不為非勇士，臨危不變始驚群。」擊拂子，下座。上堂。舉：「僧於馬祖前作四畫云：『上一畫長、下三畫短，不得道長、不得道短，離四句答某甲始得。』祖乃畫一畫云：『不得道長、不得道短，答汝了也。』後僧舉似忠國師，忠云：『何不問我？』」師云：「者僧畫長道短，要且不知飯是米做，馬祖恁麼答他，其然豈其然乎？忠國師『云何不問我？』總與一坑埋卻。何故？不見道：字經三寫，烏焉成馬。」解制，上堂。二僧齊出，師云：「一箭落雙鵰。」二僧一齊歸位，師云：「死底死，活底活。」乃云：「山僧去冬此日有一則急要事在諸公分上，諸公還知麼？若也知得，許你放膽摘楊華；脫或未然，出門便是艸。」住皈依禪寺語錄住皈依禪寺紳衿張星耀等值佛誕請上堂。問：「和尚燒香慶誕世尊，雲門便要打殺，且道與燒香慶誕是同是別？」師云：「同也同不得、別也別不得。」進云：「秖如今日和尚上堂，有人要打和尚又作麼生？」師云：「退身有分。」進云：「恁麼則釋迦不前、和尚不後？」師云：「且照顧腳跟。」僧便喝，師云：「又被風吹別調中。」乃云：「指天指地太郎當，萬古千秋是禍殃，劄破面門何處去？一年一度一燒香。」卓拄杖，下座。因事上堂。「庭前艸深一丈，格外大用無私，從前俱已不是，今日又復何非？」良久云：「三寸密藏渾是膽，一絲纔有便成冤。」

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 十八拍，就中幾箇知音？李公喫酒醉張公，知他是凡是聖？獨怪脫空寒山子，東兜西搭，逢人便道：『聚頭喧喧，那事如何？』道了，復自驀口一摑，云：『口是禍門。』大笑而去。諸兄弟！還知落處麼？毒似砒霜，甜如白蜜，須是追風良驥、拈頭會尾底，乃能見義勇為、一舉千里，便見得天之高、地之厚，皇風蕩蕩，帝道平平，五嶽鎮靜以崢嶸，百谷朝宗而浩渺。全機展拓即且置，眾中莫有見義勇為者麼？」拍禪床一下，云：「鶴有九皋難翥翼，馬無千里謾追風。」一揆禪師語錄卷第六一揆禪師語錄卷第七侍者成粲記錄拈頌古上拈頌古上世尊在第六天，說大集經，敕他方此土，人間天上，一切獰惡鬼神，悉皆輯會，受佛付囑，擁護正法。設有不赴者，四天門王，飛熱鐵輪，追之令集。既集會已，無有不順佛敕者，各發弘誓，擁護正法。唯有一魔王，謂世尊曰：「瞿曇！我待一切眾生成佛，盡眾生界空，無有眾生名字，我乃發菩提心。」師拈云：「世尊令不虛行，直得普天匝地向熱鐵輪望風乞命，魔王迅雷不及掩耳，未免一款招成。雖然，見義不為非勇士，臨危不變始驚群。」頌：看風使帆，放鷹見兔。鴨寒下水，雞寒上樹。同路不同行，同趨不同步。萬派終歸海上消，清風明月一生富。世尊因耆婆善別音響，至一塚間，見五髑髏，乃敲一髑髏問耆婆：「此生何處？」曰：「此生人道。」又敲一曰：「此生何處？」曰：「此生天道。」又別敲一，問曰：「此生何處？」耆婆罔知生處。師拈云：「世尊一味慈悲之故，不能痛下針錐，耆婆直饒一一應對分明，不免髑髏前見鬼。我若作世尊，只一敲，云：『生何道？』云：『生人道。』便云：『赤土塗牛奶。』」頌：迷頭認影，病入膏肓。善別音響，非愚即狂。山蒼蒼，水茫茫。奼女已歸霄漢去，獃郎猶自守空房。殃崛摩羅尊者因持缽至一長者門，其家婦人正值產難，長者曰：「瞿曇弟子！汝為至聖，當有何法，得免產難？」崛語長者曰：「我乍入道，未知此法，待我回問世尊，卻來相報。」乃返具事白佛，佛告殃崛：「汝速去報言：『我從賢聖法來，未曾殺生。』」殃崛奉佛語，疾往告之，其婦聞得，當時分娩。師拈云：「世尊已曲垂方便了也，殃崛持語報了也，其婦分娩了也，還有知落處者麼？人義盡從貧處斷，世情偏向有錢家。」頌：梅敷春谷，菊綻秋籬，鵠白鳥玄，物各時宜。碎啄同時兮華添錦上，推門落臼也餘力不資。雲渺渺，艸萋萋，流水何曾洗是非？世尊一日陞座，默

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: ，如何惟許展雙眉。須知不在枝頭上，自有風光一段奇。」殃崛救產難殃崛救產難拈云：「佛之所言，有照有用，能奪能縱，奈何殃崛不知利害？及往告之，其婦得聞，便乃分娩，也奇怪哉！且道靈驗在什麼處？」頌：「老樹寒梅香撲鼻，幾多遊客盡疑猜。應知不假東君力，經雪經霜花自開。」德山托缽德山托缽拈云：「車不橫推，理無曲斷，要識德山、巖頭麼？劍為不平離寶匣，藥因救病出金瓶。」頌：「縱爾當場施好手，紅心心裏中紅心。將軍若不重行令，敢保徒勞赤汗淋。」百丈野狐百丈野狐拈云：「大眾！若向不落不昧處討分曉，非但己眼不明，抑見野狐遍地。」頌：「五百生前曾錯墮，五百生後為說破。縱饒脫卻野狐身，也是炎天火裏坐。」南泉斬貓南泉斬貓拈云：「大小南泉，權衡在手，殺活全提。若老趙機關甚別，其奈劍去久矣。」頌：「兩堂雲水聚頭爭，殺活當機若個能？唯有超方出格者，纔聞舉著便翻騰。」靈雲見桃花悟道因緣靈雲見桃花悟道因緣拈云：「溈山弘開大冶，玄沙善運鉗錘，奈何靈雲是鍛過底精金？雖然，見義不為非勇士，臨危不變始驚群。」頌：「一遇桃花眼豁開，了然無物絕疑猜。千差坐斷超今古，滿面春風匝地來。」偈偈與洗心水西堂與洗心水西堂衲僧正法眼精明，見識自能深徹省。紹繼宗風永遠揚，貴乎勇猛提綱領。贈秋浦和尚之李峰贈秋浦和尚之李峰吾兄去住那伽室，獨踞峰頭眼界高。山月明時窺舞鳳，碧潭深處釣金鰲。訪雲衲明和尚訪雲衲明和尚為謁同條興轉奢，飄然一笠過煙霞。相逢漫問年來事，話到忘機日又斜。喜自覺和尚見訪喜自覺和尚見訪坐久忽聞知己到，橫披破衲一身輕。地爐煨個銕鐺子，熟煮清泉話舊情。寄懷此藥和尚寄懷此藥和尚片片殘紅點綠苔，閒攜藜杖漫徘徊。知音杳隔千峰外，三載曾無一信來。示佛月照禪人示佛月照禪人全彰覿體絕遮欄，機用迥離佛祖臼。無倚無依得自由，堪能接續吾宗後。示竹菴趙居士示竹菴趙居士洞徹無生不二旨，遭吾痛棒幾翻身，異時若欲伸冤屈，當向人前舉似人。贈含空和尚之東明贈含空和尚之東明拂拂春風楊柳生，孤帆為送吾兄行。浙江江上東山月，一片清光兩地明。示惟一張文學示惟一張文學須向分中明下落，莫從節外更生枝。威音前事如能委，夫子依然是仲尼。贈雄山賀鎮臺任江浙贈雄山賀鎮臺任江浙撫民衛國羨中良，大丈夫兒當傑烈。凜凜雄風貫斗牛，嘉聲千古振江浙。住金陵祈澤禪寺募田頤靈監院乞住金陵祈澤禪寺募田頤

Senses.Explanation: The pair links knowing the right action to remaining steady when it becomes difficult. Poshan cites an old formulation for a lay commander; Lianyue turns it toward the sharp exchange between Linji and Puhua. Shengke, Hengxiulin, Yikui, and Xianglin each make the pair a present call to answer without hesitation.

Entries.SourceTerm: 見聞如幻翳，三界若空花

Senses.PreferredTarget: Seeing and hearing are like a conjured film over the eyes; the three realms are like flowers in empty space.
AlternateTargets: What is seen and heard is like an illusory veil; the three realms are like sky-flowers.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J29/J29nB234.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yichuyuan. The pair compares seeing and hearing with an illusory obscuring film and the three realms with flowers appearing in empty space. At a funeral fire rite, Yichu Wuyuan holds up the torch and incorporates it into his own verse: penetrating the matter directly leaves it openly exposed, without concealment. He addresses the deceased practitioner, asks whether he understands, and urges him to walk freely, finding his home country wherever he meets it, before throwing down the torch. The formula supports a direct farewell amid the rite's visible action; it is not a medical diagnosis or a claim that the funeral scene physically vanishes.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J39/J39nB450.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Minshu. Minshu Ruxiang uses the pair in a series of questions about awakening through the senses. After images of waves waking dream-filled eyes and ears opening, he asks whether this is the return of one faculty to its source and the liberation of all six, quoting the formula and the following removal of the obscured root and purification of awareness. He immediately adds, 'If you have not yet awakened,' describes entanglement in mind and ignorance, and asks the assembly how to turn around. The verse must therefore be made effective in a present turning; merely repeating its account of purity does not answer his challenge.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1346.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xuefeng Huikong. Xuefeng Huikong quotes the four-line formula to a small assembly, then raises his staff and asks, 'See?' He strikes it and asks, 'Hear?' Since seeing and hearing are still present, he presses the assembly on how the obscured root can be removed and awareness become pure. Even a purity and light filling empty space, with the world appearing dreamlike, would not yet reach his monastery's novice hall. His staff makes the formula a practical question, while that severe limit prevents treating a luminous or dreamlike experience as completion.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1360.xml). Expanded Record of Chan Master Xiatang Huiyuan. In a letter, Xiatang Huiyuan quotes Manjushri's verse while discussing a lay recipient's spouse bowing a hundred times. He relates bodily, verbal and mental purity to bowing in which one's body and the Buddha are alike open space, directs the recipient to read the Surangama Scripture, and continues from the formula into entering through hearing and forgetting its object. He ends with crickets, cicadas, wind and trees as the setting in which one truly sees the bodhisattva. The ordinary sounds remain part of the instruction; the final Chinese particle does not mean 'the bodhisattva's ear.' Manjushri is the quoted voice, while Xiatang applies the words to the recipient's practice.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X73/X73n1451.xml). Expanded Record of Chan Master Cishou Huaishen. Cishou Huaishen quotes Manjushri after distinguishing the two names birth and death from a single luminous nature. He pictures the clearing of the clouds of the five aggregates and the moon's constant brightness. Yet immediately after the verse's pure awakening he says that even upon reaching this place one must still know the Chan monk's staff. Asked what that staff is, he pauses and answers, 'An order not infringed.' The quotation prepares a further demand rather than furnishing a settled description at which the assembly may stop.

ClaimAnchors.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J29/J29nB234.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yichuyuan. The pair compares seeing and hearing with an illusory obscuring film and the three realms with flowers appearing in empty space. At a funeral fire rite, Yichu Wuyuan holds up the torch and incorporates it into his own verse: penetrating the matter directly leaves it openly exposed, without concealment. He addresses the deceased practitioner, asks whether he understands, and urges him to walk freely, finding his home country wherever he meets it, before throwing down the torch. The formula supports a direct farewell amid the rite's visible action; it is not a medical diagnosis or a claim that the funeral scene physically vanishes.

ClaimAnchors.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J39/J39nB450.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Minshu. Minshu Ruxiang uses the pair in a series of questions about awakening through the senses. After images of waves waking dream-filled eyes and ears opening, he asks whether this is the return of one faculty to its source and the liberation of all six, quoting the formula and the following removal of the obscured root and purification of awareness. He immediately adds, 'If you have not yet awakened,' describes entanglement in mind and ignorance, and asks the assembly how to turn around. The verse must therefore be made effective in a present turning; merely repeating its account of purity does not answer his challenge.

ClaimAnchors.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1346.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xuefeng Huikong. Xuefeng Huikong quotes the four-line formula to a small assembly, then raises his staff and asks, 'See?' He strikes it and asks, 'Hear?' Since seeing and hearing are still present, he presses the assembly on how the obscured root can be removed and awareness become pure. Even a purity and light filling empty space, with the world appearing dreamlike, would not yet reach his monastery's novice hall. His staff makes the formula a practical question, while that severe limit prevents treating a luminous or dreamlike experience as completion.

Senses.Explanation: The pair compares seeing and hearing with an illusory obscuring film and the three realms with flowers appearing in empty space. At a funeral fire rite, Yichu Wuyuan holds up the torch and incorporates it into his own verse: penetrating the matter directly leaves it openly exposed, without concealment. He addresses the deceased practitioner, asks whether he understands, and urges him to walk freely, finding his home country wherever he meets it, before throwing down the torch. The formula supports a direct farewell amid the rite's visible action; it is not a medical diagnosis or a claim that the funeral scene physically vanishes. Minshu Ruxiang uses the pair in a series of questions about awakening through the senses. After images of waves waking dream-filled eyes and ears opening, he asks whether this is the return of one faculty to its source and the liberation of all six, quoting the formula and the following removal of the obscured root and purification of awareness. He immediately adds, 'If you have not yet awakened,' describes entanglement in mind and ignorance, and asks the assembly how to turn around. The verse must therefore be made effective in a present turning; merely repeating its account of purity does not answer his challenge. Xuefeng Huikong quotes the four-line formula to a small assembly, then raises his staff and asks, 'See?' He strikes it and asks, 'Hear?' Since seeing and hearing are still present, he presses the assembly on how the obscured root can be removed and awareness become pure. Even a purity and light filling empty space, with the world appearing dreamlike, would not yet reach his monastery's novice hall. His staff makes the formula a practical question, while that severe limit prevents treating a luminous or dreamlike experience as completion. Senses.Explanation: The fixed sequence names the ordinary functions of seeing, hearing, sensing, and knowing. Wuxiang warns that making an interpretation from them is far from the Way. Zhongfeng Mingben identifies mind itself with these functions and rejects positing a second seeing, hearing, sensing, and knowing above them. Yongming Yanshou warns against using them to construct textual interpretation, and Yuanwu Keqin says interpretive self-assertion becomes enclosed by them. In a clearly marked quotation, Dahui Zonggao cites Vimalakirti's statement that the teaching cannot be seen, heard, sensed, or known. The sequence therefore names the functions themselves, while each retained passage supplies its own predicate.

Senses.Note: Baizhang’s saying praises the heir whose insight surpasses the teacher’s rather than stopping at imitation. Chaozong explains it through Huangbo’s refusal to claim Mazu directly, and Zhulang adds his own critique of the exchange. Xixin cites the maxim when questioning hasty recognition of successors. Dabo uses it in his own sermon on a teaching that must be lived rather than only passed as words. The paired clauses keep the loss and the demanding remedy together.

Senses.Explanation: Seeing form, clarify the mind is a compact encounter formula joining visible form to immediate recognition. Yunmen Wenyan raises it as a question, a later record quotes his wording, and Baiyun Shouduan challenges an assembly with the same pair. Tian'an Sheng compares clarifying the mind by seeing form to satisfying hunger with a painted cake. The retained records therefore test the formula rather than present it as an automatic or prescribed inner procedure.

Senses.PreferredTarget: Seeing forms is not caught by forms; hearing sounds is not sound
SearchAliases: seeing forms is not caught by forms; hearing sounds is not sound
Senses.Note: Er’an asks whether a description of seeing form without being caught by form and hearing sound without resting in sound really settles contemplation. Chaozong recites the pair in a sermon, then calls that much only halfway. Minshu develops it through the claim that forms and sounds are unobstructed; Liaozong raises and strikes a whisk before reciting it. The line keeps perception in view while questioning what is taken to be known through it.

Senses.Explanation: A point of understanding is where a person's seeing stands in the exchange. Huangbo Xiyun says that having such a point amounts to being occupied with views. Tiantong Wuzheng asks where the merchant sees the Buddha awake yet has no point of understanding, while Tianyi Yihuai calls Kashyapa's point of understanding untrue. The term therefore names an assessable understanding, not eyesight.

Senses.PreferredTarget: When seeing sees seeing, that seeing is not what is seen.
AlternateTargets: At the moment seeing recognizes seeing, seeing is not an object of sight.
SearchAliases: seeing itself cannot be made an object
Senses.Note: The Shurangama Sutra joins this pair to a further claim that seeing is beyond the reach of ordinary seeing. Miyun quotes the passage, then revoices it as a challenge about a staff blow. Feiyin and Yu'an question how it works in a present assembly. Yezhu uses it in two separate staff sermons, one as a spoken answer and another as a close after drawing a mark. Qianyan cites it while urging students to continue beyond a first stage. The phrase turns attention toward the act of seeing and away from a hidden object.

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 若不見他面孔，返被他攪，妙不得靜，辦這一場公案，如何結斷？任你講得一大藏教，如何出得趙州一箇無字？一法無，萬法皆無，和這無字亦無。正與麼時，上至無量劫，下至未來際，總不出這箇時節，自然活鱍鱍地、虛靈靈地，便是清淨法身佛，不待靜而自安，不待動而常用，便是千百億化身佛，事上建立也得，理上鏟除也得。我為法王，於法自在。說一切法，於法無礙，名為講師；立一切法，於法無礙，名為律師；空一切法，於法無礙，名為禪師。雖然，更須知有法身上毘盧師始得。咄！咄！咄！沒處去。這箇說話，莫道你理會不得，便是無明也理會不得。何故？你是趙州人，我是淛間人。示祿禪人示祿禪人你既要了這一件大事，把從前知見解會束作一團，拋向他方世界，如臘月扇子相似，永不得拈著，永不得顧著，一切放下，便如死人一般、木石一般，只於行住坐臥、語默動靜、上床下地、喫粥喫飯、屙屎送尿時，單單提箇話頭與之廝捱，捱到極處，不見有佛祖玄妙，不見有世界縱橫，不見有話頭可提，不見有提話頭者。經云：「見見之時，見非是見，見猶離見，見不能及。」正與麼時，也只是工夫純一處，更須保養聖胎，自然會回機轉位，如大死人卻活，於頂門上迸出一隻眼，方到得無明門下，見得無明面孔是長是短、是闊是狹，然後上無星秤子等將來，是幾斤、是幾兩，鎔瓶盤釵釧為一塊金亦得，將一塊金為瓶盤釵釧亦得，入水入泥、入染入淨、入佛入魔亦得。然亦未可順汝意在，須入無明室，朝打三千，暮打八百，打得皮穿骨爛，痛不可忍，現出三頭六臂，倒要吞卻無明，那時無明性命在汝手裏，要殺要活、要收要放總得，所謂智過於師，方堪傳授。此非細事，不可忽。示首仁大師示首仁大師秘密一宗，顯諸佛不傳之旨，闡上上大乘之教，故能入凡入聖，入一切國土而無所入，於諸境界亦無所礙。辟如虛空，覓虛空之量了不可得。知虛空空群相有，猶有靈知，只成知解宗徒，謂了了常知，欲言之不可及，便為要妙。殊不知，知之一字，眾禍之門。直饒離文字相，離心緣相，語默不到，動靜兩忘，照用雙遣，人境俱奪，猶是法身邊事。雲門云：「法身有三種病，二種光。光不透脫，其病轉多。」杜順云：「法身流轉五道，名曰眾生。」便是這箇道理。你若打理窟不破，事上便不明。事上既不明，諸法皆有滯。諸法既有滯，持咒觀想，皆是虛妄生死根本。喚作法身佛得麼？喚作無等等咒得麼？喚作大慈悲

Senses.Explanation: The repeated word seeing to question whether seeing itself can be treated as something seen. Miyun gives the inherited sentence a present edge with his staff, while Feiyin questions whether merely quoting it completes the turn. Yu'an and Qianyan give separate teaching applications; Yezhu voices the pair in two different staff sermons.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J39/J39nB460.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Huizhou Hao of Wanshan, Luanzhou. Huizhou Hao owns the retained grading: the seeing that is not the seeing — empty flowers and sun-mirage; the seeing yet leaving the seeing — thunderbolt lightning; the seeing that cannot reach — mud washed inside the earth; the landing place — fire fetched with its smoke, the spring carried home with the moon.

Senses.Explanation: The seeing ladder of the Chan records, borrowed whole from the sutra: seeing sees and the seeing is not the seeing, the seeing yet leaves the seeing, and the seeing cannot reach — the rungs masters grade as empty flowers, lightning, and mud washed in earth. Zhangxue Tongzui sets the ladder as his case and verses it: where the seeing cannot reach, what is seeing owed? The whole garden puts forth its peach and plum at once; the wind picks the speck from the eye — Lingyun alone he allows for an author, Wenmu Nian brings it to the evening gathering: the ladder rung by rung — and the great Gautama, he says, scratching his head where it does not itch, Yi'an Shanzan runs it through his height address: the one who returns to the source shatters the ten-direction sky — not the height's face; the ladder itself — not the height's face; the all-knowing knowing pure, without two, without division, without break — not the height's face either. Fazhu Haidong pairs his verse on the ladder: the empty-kalpa round-bright of itself still, the lesser and the lesser-wrought mirrored without bias, hills and rivers and the great earth whole as ever — no sorting the Buddha tongue from the Tang tongue; the seeing that is not seeing, rounded to the bottom, ends in no-meaning and no-words, the hundred thousand steadinesses on one hair-tip, Huizhou Hao raises the line and takes its rungs one by one: the seeing that is not the seeing — empty flowers and sun-mirage; the seeing yet leaving the seeing — thunderbolt lightning; the seeing that cannot reach — mud washed inside the earth. Do you know where the World-Honored lands? Fire fetched with the smoke still on it; the spring carried home with the moon in it.

Senses.Explanation: Understanding is a person's view or interpretive grasp, something that can be held, presented, examined, or rejected. Yuanwu Keqin quotes Wuzu Fayan telling him to exhaust his understanding and calculation until they are swept away. Shending Yin says that understanding may enter subtlety without being called seeing the way. Foyan Qingyuan asks for a person whose understanding is clear and thoroughly awakened, while explicitly setting aside displays of unusual action, devices, shouts, and blows. The sole supplementary lamp narrates Fayan Wenyi presenting understandings and explanations daily until Luohan Guichen says that the Buddha Dharma is not like that. Across these records, understandings are exhausted, distinguished from seeing the way, demanded, presented, and rejected; Shending explicitly says that subtle understanding is not called seeing the way.

Occurrences.Kwic: 這著子莫說未得的人不可造次，就是得了還須保任。湧泉景欣禪師云：『我四十年在裏許，尚有走作，汝等諸人，莫開大口。』古德云：『見解人多，行解人萬中無一。若識漏未盡，敢道輪迴去在。』
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J27/J27nB189.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Sanyi Yu. The saying distinguishes plentiful understanding in ideas from rare understanding carried through in conduct. Sanyi quotes it as an unnamed ancient's words while warning that even someone who has attained something must continue to preserve it carefully. Immediately before it he separately names Yongquan Jingxin's confession of still going astray after forty years and warning others not to boast; the second quotation is not explicitly assigned to Yongquan in this witness. The following threat of continued rebirth if the leaks of consciousness remain makes the pair an admonition against premature assurance, not a statistical census of practitioners.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: J27 introduces the exact phrase with 古德云; the preceding 湧泉景欣禪師云 quote is closed before this separate 古德云 marker, so its speaker cannot safely be equated with Yongquan.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J33/J33nB294.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Liangting Ting of Yunxi. Liangting Jingting explicitly gives the pair as Jingxin's words. He then introduces the question whether the person who knows is exercising understanding in ideas or in practice, and where one establishes one's life while responding to countless affairs today. He cuts this off with 'Wrong! Wrong! It is all playing with the conscious spirit.' The quotation raises a real distinction, but this turn does not allow a new conceptual classification of the knowing person to stand as its solution. Jingxin is the quoted speaker; Liangting performs the present testing.

Occurrences.Kwic: 精嚴操履第十向上一路，千聖不傳。如大火聚，誰敢正眼而󳬇？如塗毒鼓，孰能側耳而聽？機先掣電，已屬遲疑；句下精通，猶為狂見。此何事也，而偲偲問操履，踽踽論功勛哉？然初祖云：行解相應，名之曰祖。雲居膺祖曰：那邊會得了，卻向這邊行履。涌泉曰：見解人多，行解人萬中無一。則知從上諸祖，未嘗以行解為二事也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X63/X63n1259.xml). Discourse on Training in the Chan Gate. In a section on strict conduct, Huishan Jiexian first describes the upward way as beyond what sages transmit and treats even quick or exact verbal comprehension as inadequate. He asks why one should then fuss over behavior and achievement, but counters with the first ancestor's requirement that practice and understanding correspond, Yunju's instruction to put what was understood 'over there' into conduct 'over here,' and Yongquan's pair. He concludes that the ancestors never treated practice and understanding as two separate matters. The contrast thus supports their integration, not a license to discard insight in favor of externally correct behavior alone.

The following threat of continued rebirth if the leaks of consciousness remain makes the pair an admonition against premature assurance, not a statistical census of practitioners. Liangting Jingting explicitly gives the pair as Jingxin's words. He then introduces the question whether the person who knows is exercising understanding in ideas or in practice, and where one establishes one's life while responding to countless affairs today. He cuts this off with 'Wrong! Wrong! It is all playing with the conscious spirit.' The quotation raises a real distinction, but this turn does not allow a new conceptual classification of the knowing person to stand as its solution. Jingxin is the quoted speaker; Liangting performs the present testing. In a section on strict conduct, Huishan Jiexian first describes the upward way as beyond what sages transmit and treats even quick or exact verbal comprehension as inadequate. He asks why one should then fuss over behavior and achievement, but counters with the first ancestor's requirement that practice and understanding correspond, Yunju's instruction to put what was understood 'over there' into conduct 'over here,' and Yongquan's pair. He concludes that the ancestors never treated practice and understanding as two separate matters. The contrast thus supports their integration, not a license to discard insight in favor of externally correct behavior alone.

Senses.Explanation: To see the Way is to realize or manifest what the retained records call the Way, rather than to see with ordinary eyesight. Bodhidharma's attributed teaching calls seeing no thing “seeing the Way.” Yongming Yanshou calls understanding the one true mind seeing the Way; Nanyue Huairang rejects seeing it through formation and decay; Dahui Zonggao says seeing the Way precedes cultivating it; Yunmen Mailanghuai makes it the basis of the sages' learning; and Yuan'an Liao uses the phrase in a verse on the dragon's roar in a dry tree.

Entries.SourceTerm: 見道方修道，不見復何修

Senses.PreferredTarget: Only after seeing the Way can one cultivate the Way; without seeing it, what could one cultivate?
AlternateTargets: Seeing the Way comes before cultivating it; without seeing, what is there to cultivate?
Senses.Note: The local exchange governs each application; uncertain imagery and memorial claims are kept qualified.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師《無修偈》曰：「見道方修道，不見復何修？道性如虛空，虛空何處修？遍觀修道者，撥火覓浮漚。但看弄傀儡，線斷一時休。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (B/B25/B25n0144.xml). Zutang Ji (Anthology from the Patriarchs’ Hall). In Sikong Benjing's dialogue, Huizhen asks whether Buddha and the way are one or two and who establishes their names. Sikong denies that these names or the mind establishing them have an independent substance. After Huizhen's praise, he gives the 'Verse on No Cultivation': only on seeing the way can one cultivate it; without seeing, what is there to cultivate? The way is like empty space, which offers no place to work on. The verse continues with fire-stirring, bubbles and a puppet whose motion stops when its string breaks. The headword questions cultivation as a manufactured object within this conversation, while the surrounding dialogue actively examines the student's assumptions.

Occurrences.Kwic: 臘八，上堂。「見道方修道，不見復何修？道性如虛空，虛空何所修？廣西蠻，福建子，川僧浙僧一隊行，驢腳、馬腳，有眼如盲、有口如啞，大似好人不肯做，偏要屎裏臥。「有般漢聞與麼道，便云：『世尊睹明星聻。』殊不知，世尊未入雪山以前錯了也、既入雪山以後亦錯了也、及乎臘八夜睹明星又錯了也，是汝諸人切莫將錯就錯好。雖然，且道：元上座還有錯處也無？」良久，云：「錯，錯，山門飛入藏樓角。」以拄杖卓一卓，下座。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J28/J28nB202.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baichi. On the Buddha's awakening day, Baichi Xingyuan repeats the opening of Sikong's verse about seeing before cultivation and the way like empty space. He then castigates the assembled practitioners. If someone appeals to the Buddha's sight of the bright star, Baichi says there was error before entering the snowy mountains, after entering and on seeing the star; listeners must not add another mistake. Asked within his own address whether he too errs, he answers 'Wrong, wrong' with a gate flying into the scripture tower, and strikes his staff. The quoted maxim is not allowed to become a safe platform for condemning everyone else; Baichi brings his own judgment under the same test.

Occurrences.Kwic: 然又不可不履踐，故曰：『見道方修道，不見復何修？』又云：『理雖頓悟，事以漸除。』若一知而不保任，久久失初，恐醍醐翻成毒藥。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J33/J33nB286.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yingningjing. In a sustained argument about lineage teaching, Yingning Zhijing refuses to split lived practice from unfettered functioning. Step-by-step descriptions may end with remedy and illness gone and confusion and awakening dissolved, yet practice must not be abandoned. He therefore quotes the seeing-and-cultivating pair, followed by sudden insight with matters gradually cleared. Without continued care, he warns, an early recognition can be lost, like good food becoming poison. Two wheels and two wings illustrate why either side alone fails. The headword retains Sikong's earlier verse as its source, while Yingning's present use affirms sustained enactment rather than endorsing a simple ban on cultivation.

Occurrences.Kwic: 所謂見道方修道，不見復何修？但專一守之，如執杖牧牛，勿令放逸，莫管相應不相應、正邪不正邪、出此沒彼，盡未來際不動不變，始是工夫純熟，始是得力處，亦不得打淨潔毬子。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X71/X71n1404.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Wu’an Puning. The scripture keeper Longjue reports to Wu'an Puning that sustained attention to the word 'no' ended in a sudden settling, but asks whether his experience is right. Wu'an welcomes the report as recognition of a small path by which one can begin, and quotes the seeing-and-cultivating pair. He urges steady care like tending an ox, then refuses merely polishing a pure state: the word 'no,' repeated calm and even the wonderful experience must be thrown away together. Further illnesses and a point beyond still remain to be seen through. The headword is the older maxim used in this present instruction, and Wu'an's encouragement does not certify the reported state as a final completion.

Senses.Explanation: To open one’s mouth is the visible onset of speaking, repeatedly made the exact pressure point of a Chan exchange. In the Guizong case an unnamed monk is struck precisely when he is about to open his mouth; in Xuedou Chongxian’s meeting with Zhimen, the second blow falls at the same instant. Yuanwu stops Kaifu Daoning as soon as he begins, while Dahui threatens a hot iron wheel at the mere move. Other addresses demand that the assembly open its mouths or direct recognition to what precedes opening mouth and raising intention. Foyin’s portrait verse turns an open-mouthed smile into a public question. Zen bends an ordinary bodily transition into the timed boundary where an answer is demanded, interrupted, struck, or forestalled.

Senses.Explanation: The moment one opens the mouth, it is wrong. The complete sayings make error coincide with beginning to speak, often paired with loss through silence. Error coincides with beginning speech and is bounded by that dilemma. Miyin says even a thousand Buddhas go wrong on opening their mouths in his own hall sermon. Zhean warns his assembly that opening the mouth is already wrong when the final moment arrives.

Senses.PreferredTarget: open your mouth and you are already wrong

Senses.Note: The exact phrase is not a ban on all recorded speech: masters utter it, ask for rapid answers after it, pair it with closed-mouth loss, and continue the exchange. Those observable uses are why the preferred target preserves the self-applying grammar.

SearchAliases: open your mouth and be wrong
Senses.Explanation: Open your mouth and you are already wrong functions as both a self-verdict and an interview challenge. Zhenzhou Dabe applies it to his own attempted answer. Po'an Zuxian pairs it with missing as soon as the mind frames a response; Wuzhun Shifan pairs it with being lost when the mouth stays closed. Baishan Dekai and Guangming Benyuan use it while still demanding an answer. The formula therefore catches both speaking and strategic silence without defining silence as the solution.

Senses.PreferredTarget: Speak, and it becomes two stakes
SearchAliases: speak, and it becomes two stakes
Senses.Note: “Speak, and it becomes two stakes” images a response that splits what it tries to name. Yikui opens a sermon with it, then says silence falls into another trap. Wanru likewise contrasts speech and silence; Tianan asks what remains after both fail. Yun’e rules out the two ends and a settled middle. Guxue asks whether his own teaching follows or betrays the old saying, while Eryin links the phrase to a merely expressive raised eyebrow. The point is the test of a response, not a simple prohibition on words.

Senses.PreferredTarget: Opening the mouth makes two stakes; keeping silent still falls into two or three
AlternateTargets: Speaking splits the point, yet silence also falls into division
SearchAliases: open mouth two stakes silence two or three

Occurrences.Kwic: 夏蒲月，節屆天中，賜進士及第、欽授翰林院修撰、充纂修明史一統志兩館纂修官、甲戌科會試同考沈廷文元洲氏拜題。林賓敘敘神龍韜藏於巨海，以時起而澤物，則變化無方。有情且爾，矧達道之世出者乎？予叔即和尚，少具超方之志，挺卓不群，性稟至孝，因以孝聞。自弱齡削䰂後，遍參知識，苦工十餘祀，出入內典，吞吐百家。其識弘、其用博，發為文字，皆寓至理。自謂識量依通，未為究竟，輒揮去，卒力蒲團上復九載。一日，當臘月三十，於撲焚處撞破勝熱面門，打失自家鼻孔，直下如火裏青蓮，始得大事了畢。既印可于黃檗隱大師，甘活埋於雪峰古法窟，道香󵐿揜，塞滿閻浮。時節已彰，皤然應聘，出世于崇福，繼開山于廣壽，現身法海，示大津梁。上而王公碩德，次而緇褐異宗，聞名向化，覿面歸依，隨機攝受，頓入直指堂奧。愧賓風塵俗漢，兼以山川問之，未能躬承法誨，祗從頒示尊錄中神領棒喝，而撫膺自腆己爾。重披二會新錄及勘辨機緣，猶如那伽出海，雲雨相隨，於霎然雷奔電掣中，令人脫黏解縛，得大自在。外於讚頌詩偈等篇，不異化溥春工，卷舒無蹟，舉地皆成簇錦蒸霞，非深得少林不傳之宗，曷能闡古今未發之蘊哉？然此猶言其觕，未盡其徵。以和尚之道之德，足以陶三乘、津九族，起東山之正續、昇濟北之未墮，翼贊皇圖、光揚聖教，俾垂蔭於來際，其視玄言機用，特緒餘耳。賓塵列子行，曷敢為出世大人作先聲地？第當

ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 伊指出火中冰。囑普門智禪人囑普門智禪人百草頭邊真祖意，持來默默相分付；法門重任自當知，未可於人輕吐露。囑海藏深禪人囑海藏深禪人臨濟當年第一機，只傳活棒不傳衣；果然做得他家子，喝下承當也是遲。行腳行腳師一日謂眾曰：「淨倫，滇南昆明康氏。父泰、母何氏，生子四，倫居末。生宣德丁未，正統丁巳年甫十一入學，庚申是年十四出家，受業本府太華無極泰和尚。戊辰春年二十一，因請給遂謁大方，究明大事。天順癸未臘末，參見古庭老和尚於浮山，是年已三十七矣。自戊辰及癸未十六七年間，江南江北經寒經暑，話頭上冊子裏掠得些子古人汗臭氣，迨見老和尚總不當得。成化乙酉秋九月別浮山，丁亥三月京開山萬福，遂自領眾，戊戌夏謝院事閑居。癸卯春之五臺，掛錫顯通約有年餘，常與數輩禪流者朝夕論其本有。丙午京中飯僧，弘治庚戌秋赴顯通，請淨業堂撫眾。壬子夏，是年六十有六，即京之舊隱，俟其終身，然幻跡去在又未必其何如。於戲！人之有生為難，棲身方服之下更是為難。古云：『衣線下未明大事，誠為苦也！』可不勉哉！可不勉哉！因姑述此，以冀吾徒參學者，慎勿我效焉！」七言律七言律次喬武庫縉金山勝覽韻次喬武庫縉金山勝覽韻妙高臺上昔年遊，想遍山中景物幽；出洞白雲含海曙，映窗晴雪湛江流。好音常聽樹頭鳥，相對不飛沙際鷗；西望金陵千古意，蔥蔥佳氣帝王州。洞口閒雲淡不飛，亭高真與世途違；青

ClaimAnchors.ClaimText: 寺為密菴傑祖開山之地，重披荊莽，提唱宗風
ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 山，三十五年，大其獅吼，櫛風沐雨，蒞眾勤勞，卒為宗門砥柱，克紹宏模，功勳蓋代，洵法門之盛事也。當是時，海內崇其道化，如汾州雙髻，儼然再來。嗟乎，先世之建立光明如此，而為之後者不能繼武承勝，接其標流，豈不令披燈續史之賢，瞻妙高而詠歎哉？吼和尚以分座宿將，起而嗣之，二十餘年，不言之教，電激風馳；不令之機，山行水立。至若奪五宗之旗鼓，剖差別之門庭，開開闔闔、變變化化，如天之象緯、人之絲綸，雖本於家法，神而明之，皆不出吾和尚掌握中。所謂先後同揆，古今一轍，不其然乎？聞和尚在天目時，截甕為鐺，燃膏代獨，苦參力究，方得了一大事因緣。既而出世武林大覺禪寺，寺為密菴傑祖開山之地，重披荊莽，提唱宗風。靈隱老和尚歎為猶子之賢，而遣使齎供，并為增置寮舍，其亦有玅喜、天童之遺風歟？嘗攷之燈史，古來尊宿名重王侯者，代不乏人，而修齡宿福，未必能兼。和尚得五百餘甲子，去趙州之年不遠，其主祖山，恒滿萬指，福與齒俱隆。及其晚年，會聖駕南巡駐驆，優崇曠典，近古未有。蓋其一生，沖懷恬澹，耆艾康強，儀式型祖宗之德，激揚開後學之蒙，故一語一言，取法從上。讀是錄者，須向筆墨未形、齒縫未開會得，早落第二。若止以父母所生之眼，尋行逐句，豈和尚說法之意哉？萬峰同戒錄序萬峰同戒錄序禪宗律學，佛祖慧命所在。方今法道下衰、人根卑弱，擔荷如來心印者，可不並勵焉？昔

ClaimAnchors.ClaimText: 出世于崇福，繼開山于廣壽
ClaimAnchors.Kwic: 夏蒲月，節屆天中，賜進士及第、欽授翰林院修撰、充纂修明史一統志兩館纂修官、甲戌科會試同考沈廷文元洲氏拜題。林賓敘敘神龍韜藏於巨海，以時起而澤物，則變化無方。有情且爾，矧達道之世出者乎？予叔即和尚，少具超方之志，挺卓不群，性稟至孝，因以孝聞。自弱齡削䰂後，遍參知識，苦工十餘祀，出入內典，吞吐百家。其識弘、其用博，發為文字，皆寓至理。自謂識量依通，未為究竟，輒揮去，卒力蒲團上復九載。一日，當臘月三十，於撲焚處撞破勝熱面門，打失自家鼻孔，直下如火裏青蓮，始得大事了畢。既印可于黃檗隱大師，甘活埋於雪峰古法窟，道香󵐿揜，塞滿閻浮。時節已彰，皤然應聘，出世于崇福，繼開山于廣壽，現身法海，示大津梁。上而王公碩德，次而緇褐異宗，聞名向化，覿面歸依，隨機攝受，頓入直指堂奧。愧賓風塵俗漢，兼以山川問之，未能躬承法誨，祗從頒示尊錄中神領棒喝，而撫膺自腆己爾。重披二會新錄及勘辨機緣，猶如那伽出海，雲雨相隨，於霎然雷奔電掣中，令人脫黏解縛，得大自在。外於讚頌詩偈等篇，不異化溥春工，卷舒無蹟，舉地皆成簇錦蒸霞，非深得少林不傳之宗，曷能闡古今未發之蘊哉？然此猶言其觕，未盡其徵。以和尚之道之德，足以陶三乘、津九族，起東山之正續、昇濟北之未墮，翼贊皇圖、光揚聖教，俾垂蔭於來際，其視玄言機用，特緒餘耳。賓塵列子行，曷敢為出世大人作先聲地？第當

Senses.Explanation: To found a monastery is to establish a monastic seat and begin its life as a community. Jinglun dates his founding of Wanfu in the capital and immediately says that he then led its assembly. A preface identifies another monastery as the place founded by Mi’an Xianjie before describing the clearing of its overgrowth and revival of its teaching. Lin Bin likewise distinguishes Jifei Ruyi’s coming forth at Chongfu from his subsequent founding of Guangshou. In these passages the term names institutional establishment, not merely entering an existing abbacy.

Occurrences.Kwic: 於人。畢竟如何？青天無電影，火裏自生蓮。覺皇寶殿陞梁上堂，拈香祝聖竟，乃云：白雲禪窟，列祖宗風，斯道常存，千古如昨。山僧今日向這裏重插一莖草，雖則虗空樓閣，却從實地興修。須知這一片實地，人人本具，未嘗欠少，無量劫來常在其中經行坐臥，只是不曾踏著。既常在其中，為甚麼不曾踏著？不見道：日用不知。若也知得，一任經天緯地、旋乾轉坤，熱惱場中開闢清凉世界、紅塵堆裏建立水月道場，普與盡大地一切有性無性同明此事、同證此法，同度生死河、同達涅槃岸，圖報莫報之恩、仰助無為之化。只如今日直豎擎天玉柱、高陞承棟綵梁，實地上一句如何道？究竟不曾離脚下，須知步步自騰騰。復舉：僧問開山約祖和尚：不坐偏空堂、不居無學位，此人合向什麼處安置？祖云：青天無電影。師云：山僧則不然，今日有人問：不坐偏空堂、不居無學位，此人合向什麼處安置？但向他道：煩惱海中為雨露，無明山上作雲雷。且道與約祖是同是別？有人辨得出，許渠具眼。覺皇寶殿告成，上堂。師拈拄杖，云：華嚴經中道：華藏世界所有塵，一一塵中見法界。寶光化佛如雲集，此是如來剎自在。所以，盡法界、虗空界，無一剎一塵不有釋迦如來坐寶宮殿，為一切眾生轉大法輪，盡未來際無有間斷。山僧今日向一毛端上拈出一剎，與彼眾剎互相照耀、互相涉入，是我現前眾位宰官、居士、善男、信女以及法門眷屬，各捨所有，共相贊成，亦是

Senses.Explanation: A founding abbot is the person remembered as the first presiding elder of an established monastery. Weilin Daopei raises a monk’s question addressed to the identified master Yuezu as the founding abbot. Yuezu is the title-bearing addressee in the raised case, while Weilin owns the present utterance; no exact roster alias is available for linking Yuezu. This title is a different referent from the verbal act of founding.

Senses.Explanation: To “awaken” is to come into an awakening event or, in a causative clause, to bring others into it. Fayan Wenyi’s record narrates Tiantai Deshao suddenly awakening while seated beside an exchange and Yongming Daoqian awakening after Fayan answers “empty.” Zhongfeng Mingben says that a time of awakening may come without notice, yet elsewhere warns against producing a mind that seeks it quickly. Yongming Yanshou uses the verb transitively for awakening all beings; Tianru Weize turns that formula around and speaks of using beings’ knowledge and vision to awaken the buddhas. Ying'an Tanhua joins it to the face before one’s parents were born. One lamp biography supplies Angulimala’s completed event. Completed, prospective, critical, and inverted clauses remain grammatical and rhetorical uses of one event.
